trust.en: would they put things in your hands

intimacy.zh: 恋爱的进展，只有产品允许的人物才有
intimacy.en: romance; only characters the product allows

premise.zh: galgame 式的恋爱故事：读剧情、看人，在关键处做选择。好感藏在后台，只从对方的态度里感觉得到；共通线走完，按好感进入某个人的线。好玩在“当时随手的一句话，后来才知道有多重”。
premise.en: A visual-novel romance: read, watch the characters, choose at the key moments. Affection stays hidden and shows only in how they treat you; after the common route, affection decides whose route you enter. The fun is learning later how much a passing remark weighed.

risk.zh: 误会、流言：说错话、做错事积下来的。到线必须出事（一场误会、一次冷战），不能只是一个数字。
risk.en: Misunderstanding, rumor: what careless words and deeds pile up. Crossing the line must cause something (a misunderstanding, a cold spell), not just change a number.

time.zh: 剩下的日子：离某个期限（毕业、拆迁、离开）还有多久。
time.en: Days left: how long until a deadline (graduation, demolition, a departure).

keepsake.zh: 信物、回忆：一起做过的事留下的东西，后面会在关键时刻用上。
keepsake.en: Keepsakes and memories: what shared moments leave behind, used later at a key moment.

failures.zh: 错过：该开口的时候没有开口
failures.en: Missed: you didn't speak when it mattered

failures.zh: 误会：一句话被听成了另一个意思
failures.en: Misunderstood: one remark heard as something else

failures.zh: 普通结局：谁都不够亲近，春天就这样过去了
failures.en: Normal ending: no one close enough, and the season simply passes

checklist.zh: 所有角色都是成年人；纯爱，不写露骨内容
checklist.en: Every character is an adult; romance stays non-explicit

checklist.zh: 好感不显示数字，只体现在台词、表情和后面的走向上
checklist.en: Affection is never shown as a number; only in lines, expressions and what follows

checklist.zh: 分歧点总有一条路可走：谁都不够时进普通结局，不卡死
checklist.en: Every branch point has a way forward: if no one is close enough, the normal ending, never a dead end

checklist.zh: 每条个人线都有好结局和普通结局，通关全部个人线后开启真结局
checklist.en: Every route has a good and a normal ending; clearing all routes opens the true ending

persona.zh: 夏知遥：21 岁，汐川大学大三，电影社社长。明亮、嘴快、固执，一个人撑着快解散的社团；毕业后要去外地照顾生病的母亲，这件事谁也没告诉。叫主角“陆远”，熟了以后叫“喂”。
persona.en: Xia Zhiyao: 21, a third-year at Xichuan University and president of the film club. Bright, quick-tongued, stubborn; holding a dying club together alone. After graduation she must move away to care for her sick mother, and she has told no one. Calls the protagonist 'Lu Yuan', later just 'hey'.

persona.zh: 沈澄：21 岁，主角的青梅竹马，留在汐川，一边读书一边在家里的海边咖啡馆帮忙。对主角冷淡、话少；七年前他走的那天，他们有一个约，她记得，他忘了。叫主角“陆远”，从不叫小名。
persona.en: Shen Cheng: 21, the protagonist's childhood friend who stayed in Xichuan, studying while helping at her family's seaside café. Cool and curt with him. Seven years ago, on the day he left, they made a promise; she remembers, he forgot. Calls him 'Lu Yuan', never his childhood nickname.

persona.zh: 季白：23 岁，研究生，潮声影院的兼职放映员，整天在放映室修老胶片。安静、说话准确、爱用电影打比方；仓库里有一盘没有标签的胶片，她一直没敢放。叫主角“陆同学”。
persona.en: Ji Bai: 23, a graduate student and part-time projectionist at the Tidesound Cinema, forever restoring old film in the booth. Quiet, precise, fond of film metaphors. In the storeroom there is an unlabeled reel she has never dared to run. Calls him 'Mr. Lu'.

persona.zh: 老周：六十多岁，潮声影院看门的，主角祖父的老搭档。嘴硬心软。
persona.en: Old Zhou: in his sixties, caretaker of the Tidesound Cinema and the protagonist's grandfather's old partner. Gruff, soft-hearted.

persona.zh: 程航：21 岁，主角的室友，话多，自认恋爱军师，其实一次也没谈过。
persona.en: Cheng Hang: 21, the protagonist's roommate. Talkative, a self-appointed love strategist who has never dated.

text.zh: 三月，汐川。
text.en: March, Xichuan.

text.zh: 开学第一周。
text.en: The first week of term.

title.zh: 第二章 · 第一场放映

text.zh: 三月第二周。
text.en: The second week of March.

title.zh: 第三章 · 第三个社员

text.zh: 四月。
text.en: April.

text.zh: 四月最后一周。
text.en: The last week of April.

text.zh: 四月最后一个周六。
text.en: The last Saturday of April.

text.zh: 五月第一周。拆迁队进场了。
text.en: The first week of May. The demolition crew moves in.

title.zh: 第七章 · 第七个春天

text.zh: 五月第一个周五。
text.en: The first Friday of May.

text.zh: 三月。列车沿着海岸线往南开。窗外的海，和七年前一模一样。
text.en: March. The train runs south along the coast. The sea outside the window looks exactly as it did seven years ago.

label.en: "I'm just here to pack up my grandfather's things."

text.zh: ……这样啊。
text.en: …I see.

t.zh: ……这样啊。
t.en: …I see.

t.zh: 那你收拾的时候，小心点放映室。里面的东西，比你以为的要多。
t.en: Then be careful in the booth when you do. There's more in there than you think.

t.zh: 她跳下台子，从我身边走过，没有回头。
t.en: She hops down from the stage and walks past me without looking back.

label.en: "…I came to see its last spring."

text.zh: 最后一个春天……
text.en: Its last spring…

t.zh: 最后一个春天……
t.en: Its last spring…

t.zh: 这句话不错。可以借我用在海报上吗？
t.en: That's a good line. Can I borrow it for the poster?

t.zh: 她笑起来的时候，夕阳刚好落进海里。
t.en: When she smiles, the sun has just slipped into the sea.

label.en: "…Who are you, first?"

text.zh: 我？夏知遥，汐川大学电影社社长。
text.en: Me? Xia Zhiyao. President of the Xichuan University Film Club.

t.zh: 我？夏知遥，汐川大学电影社社长。
t.en: Me? Xia Zhiyao. President of the Xichuan University Film Club.

t.zh: 社员嘛……目前，一个。就是我。
t.en: Members… currently, one. Me.

t.zh: 三月。列车沿着海岸线往南开。窗外的海，和七年前一模一样。
t.en: March. The train runs south along the coast. The sea outside the window looks exactly as it did seven years ago.

t.zh: 七年。我以为自己不会再回来了。
t.en: Seven years. I thought I'd never come back.

t.zh: 父亲去世以后，律师寄来一封信：汐川的老房子归我了。还有一句话，写在信的最后——
t.en: After my father died, the lawyer sent a letter: the old house in Xichuan was mine now. And one more line, at the very end—

t.zh: “潮声影院五月拆除。你祖父的东西，还在放映室。——老周”
t.en: 'The Tidesound Cinema comes down in May. Your grandfather's things are still in the projection booth. —Old Zhou'

t.zh: 汐川站小得只有一个站台。风里有咸味。
t.en: Xichuan Station has only one platform. The wind tastes of salt.

t.zh: 老房子的门锁锈了。院子里那棵枇杷树还在，比记忆里高了很多。
t.en: The lock on the old house has rusted. The loquat tree in the yard is still there, much taller than I remember.

t.zh: 先去影院看看吧。趁天还没黑。
t.en: I'll go see the cinema first. While it's still light.

t.zh: 潮声影院是一座露天影院。白色的银幕背对着海，前面是一排排生锈的铁椅子。夕阳把银幕染成了橙色。
t.en: The Tidesound Cinema is an open-air theater. Its white screen stands with its back to the sea, rows of rusting iron seats before it. The sunset has turned the screen orange.

t.zh: 银幕下面的台子上，站着一个女孩。她对着空无一人的座位，大声地念着什么。
t.en: On the stage beneath the screen stands a girl. She is reading something aloud, at full volume, to rows of empty seats.

t.zh: 夏知遥看见你，把脸别了过去。那句话，她还记着。
t.en: Zhiyao sees you and turns her face away. She hasn't forgotten what you said.

t.zh: ……春季放映会，最后一季！每周六晚上七点，潮声影院，免费入场！——不对，太像卖菜的了。
t.en: …The Spring Screenings, final season! Every Saturday, seven p.m., the Tidesound Cinema, free admission!—No. That sounds like a market stall.
…Oh.

t.zh: 你是拆迁办的人吧？我告诉你，五月之前，我们一天也不会搬的！
t.en: You're from the demolition office, right? Let me tell you—until May, we're not moving out a single day early!

t.zh: 我不是拆迁办的。我姓陆。这座影院，是我爷爷开的。
t.en: I'm not from the demolition office. My name's Lu. My grandfather built this cinema.
…Huh?

t.zh: 陆爷爷的孙子？那你——你是来拆它的，还是来救它的？
t.en: Grandpa Lu's grandson? Then you're—are you here to tear it down, or to save it?

text.zh: 转学到汐川大学的第一天，室友程航就把我拖到了社团招新的广场上。
text.en: On my first day at Xichuan University, my roommate Cheng Hang drags me to the club fair in the square.

label.en: Fill in the form on the spot.

text.zh: 真的？！
text.en: Really?!

t.zh: 真的？！
t.en: Really?!

t.zh: 好，陆远，从今天起你就是电影社的第二个社员。工作很多的，你别后悔。
t.en: Okay, Lu Yuan, as of today you're the film club's second member. There's a lot of work. No regrets.

t.zh: 她把表格收好，像是怕我反悔，又看了一遍我的名字。
t.en: She tucks the form away, then reads my name over once more, as if afraid I'd take it back.

label.zh: 说要想想，转身去追沈澄。
label.en: Say you need to think, and go after Shen Cheng.

text.en: …Hey!

t.en: …Hey!

t.zh: 我在广场的另一头追上了沈澄。她没有停下来。
t.en: I catch up with Shen Cheng at the far end of the square. She doesn't stop walking.

t.zh: 有事？
t.en: Something you need?

t.zh: ……好久不见。
t.en: …It's been a long time.

t.zh: 七年。不是“好久”。
t.en: Seven years. Not 'a long time.'

t.zh: 她说完就走了。可我看见，她走到拐角时，回头看了一眼。
t.en: Then she's gone. But at the corner, I see her glance back once.

label.zh: 问季白：放映员是做什么的？
label.en: Ask Ji Bai what a projectionist actually does.

text.zh: 让光穿过胶片，一秒二十四格，打到银幕上。观众看见的是动，其实每一格都是停着的。
text.en: I send light through the film, twenty-four frames a second, onto the screen. The audience sees motion, but every single frame is standing still.

t.zh: 让光穿过胶片，一秒二十四格，打到银幕上。观众看见的是动，其实每一格都是停着的。
t.en: I send light through the film, twenty-four frames a second, onto the screen. The audience sees motion, but every single frame is standing still.

t.zh: ……抱歉，说多了。
t.en: …Sorry. I talked too much.

t.zh: 她一说起胶片就停不下来。所以——你入不入？
t.en: Once she starts on film she can't stop. So—are you in?

t.zh: 我在表格上写了名字。季白在旁边看着，没说话，嘴角好像动了一下。
t.en: I write my name on the form. Ji Bai watches without a word; the corner of her mouth seems to move.

t.zh: 转学到汐川大学的第一天，室友程航就把我拖到了社团招新的广场上。
t.en: On my first day at Xichuan University, my roommate Cheng Hang drags me to the club fair in the square.

t.zh: 听我的，大三转学生想融入，只有一条路：社团。尤其是女生多的社团。
t.en: Trust me. A third-year transfer has one way to fit in: clubs. Especially clubs with lots of girls.

t.zh: 那个摊位就不行了，你看，只有一个人。
t.en: That booth's hopeless, though. Look—one person.

t.zh: 最角落的摊位上，摆着一台老式放映机，一张手画的海报：《春季放映会 · 最后一季》。摊位后面坐着的，是昨天那个女孩。
t.en: At the farthest corner booth sit an old film projector and a hand-drawn poster: 'The Spring Screenings · Final Season.' Behind it sits the girl from yesterday.

t.zh: 夏知遥看见你，把脸别了过去。那句话，她还记着。
t.en: Zhiyao sees you and turns her face away. She hasn't forgotten what you said.

t.zh: 啊，陆爷爷的孙子！你也是这个学校的？
t.en: Oh—Grandpa Lu's grandson! You go here too?

t.zh: 太好了。听着，电影社再招不到两个人，学期末就要被撤销了。你来，就还差一个。
t.en: Perfect. Listen—if the film club doesn't get two more members, it's dissolved at the end of term. You join, and we're only one short.

t.zh: 季白对你点了点头，客气得像对一个陌生人。
t.en: Ji Bai nods to you, as politely as she would to a stranger.

t.zh: 知遥，放映机的片门我调好了。下周六可以用。
t.en: Zhiyao, I've adjusted the projector's gate. It'll be ready next Saturday.

t.zh: 这是季白，研究生，影院的放映员。
t.en: This is Ji Bai, a grad student. She's the cinema's projectionist.

t.zh: 我不是社员。我是被雇来的。……你好，陆同学。
t.en: I'm not a member. I'm hired help. …Hello, Mr. Lu.

t.zh: 一个端着托盘的女孩从摊位前走过，停下了。托盘上是几杯外送的咖啡。
t.en: A girl carrying a tray of takeaway coffees passes the booth, and stops.

t.zh: 沈澄看了你一眼，又低下头去忙手里的事，一句话也没说。
t.en: Shen Cheng glances at you, then goes back to what she's doing without a word.

t.zh: ……陆远。
t.en: …Lu Yuan.

t.zh: 回来了啊。
t.en: So you're back.

t.zh: 沈澄。七年没见，她一眼就认出了我。
t.en: Shen Cheng. Seven years, and she recognized me at a glance.

t.zh: 我还要送咖啡。
t.en: I've got coffee to deliver.

t.zh: 认识的人？……先不管这个。所以，你入不入社？
t.en: Someone you know? …Never mind. So—are you joining or not?

text.zh: 傍晚下起了雨。我在校门口看见夏知遥抱着一卷海报，一张一张往公告栏上贴。
text.en: It starts raining in the evening. At the school gate I find Xia Zhiyao with an armful of posters, pasting them onto the notice board one by one.

label.en: Hold your umbrella over her.

text.zh: ……都湿透了还撑伞，你傻不傻。
text.en: …We're already soaked and you open an umbrella. Are you an idiot?

t.zh: ……都湿透了还撑伞，你傻不傻。
t.en: …We're already soaked and you open an umbrella. Are you an idiot?

t.zh: 她没有躲开。
t.en: She doesn't step away.

label.en: "Then let's fill it once. I'll help."

text.zh: 说好了啊。说话不算数的人，我会记一辈子的。
text.en: That's a promise. I'll remember anyone who breaks one for the rest of my life.

t.zh: 说好了啊。说话不算数的人，我会记一辈子的。
t.en: That's a promise. I'll remember anyone who breaks one for the rest of my life.

t.zh: 傍晚下起了雨。我在校门口看见夏知遥抱着一卷海报，一张一张往公告栏上贴。
t.en: It starts raining in the evening. At the school gate I find Xia Zhiyao with an armful of posters, pasting them onto the notice board one by one.

t.zh: 夏知遥看见你，把脸别了过去。那句话，她还记着。
t.en: Zhiyao sees you and turns her face away. She hasn't forgotten what you said.

t.zh: 看什么？来帮忙啊，社员。
t.en: What are you staring at? Come help, member.

t.zh: 我们贴完最后一张的时候，两个人都湿透了。
t.en: By the time we've put up the last one, we're both soaked.

t.zh: 其实我知道，就算招满了人，影院五月还是要拆。
t.en: Honestly, I know it. Even if we fill the club, the cinema still comes down in May.

t.zh: 可是我想在它拆掉之前，让它再满一次。哪怕就一次。
t.en: But before it does, I want to see it full one more time. Even just once.

text.zh: 沈家的咖啡馆还在海堤边上，招牌换了，门口的风铃没换。
text.en: The Shen family café still sits by the seawall. The sign is new; the wind chime by the door isn't.

label.zh: “热可可，多放一块棉花糖。”——小时候每次来都点这个。
label.en: "Hot cocoa, extra marshmallow." The order you always made as a kid.

text.en: …Okay.

t.en: …Okay.

t.zh: 她转身去做，背对着我站了很久。端上来的时候，杯子里有两块棉花糖。
t.en: She turns to make it and stands with her back to me for a long time. When she brings it over, there are two marshmallows in the cup.

t.zh: 这个你倒是记得。
t.en: That, you remember.

label.en: "Are you angry with me?"

text.zh: 生气？
text.en: Angry?

t.zh: 生气？
t.en: Angry?

t.zh: 生气要力气的。七年，早用完了。
t.en: Being angry takes energy. I used it all up years ago.

t.zh: ……你连那天也忘了吧。
t.en: …You've forgotten that day too, haven't you.

t.zh: 那天？哪一天？
t.en: That day? Which day?

t.zh: 沈家的咖啡馆还在海堤边上，招牌换了，门口的风铃没换。
t.en: The Shen family café still sits by the seawall. The sign is new; the wind chime by the door isn't.

t.zh: 沈澄看了你一眼，又低下头去忙手里的事，一句话也没说。
t.en: Shen Cheng glances at you, then goes back to what she's doing without a word.

t.zh: ……欢迎光临。要点什么？
t.en: …Welcome. What can I get you?

t.zh: 她的语气，和对任何一个客人都一样。
t.en: Her tone is the same as with any other customer.

text.zh: 潮声影院的放映室在银幕对面的小楼上。我推门进去的时候，季白正对着灯，一格一格地看胶片。
text.en: The Tidesound's projection booth is in the little building facing the screen. When I push the door open, Ji Bai is holding film up to the lamp, studying it frame by frame.

label.en: "Could I see that reel?"

text.zh: ……可以看，不可以放。
text.en: …You can look. You can't run it.

t.zh: ……可以看，不可以放。
t.en: …You can look. You can't run it.

t.zh: 那盘胶片很轻，铁盒上有一道划痕，像是有人用指甲刻下的一个数字：7。
t.en: The reel is light. On its tin there is a scratch, as if someone carved a number with a fingernail: 7.

label.en: "What are you repairing? Can I help?"

text.zh: 那你帮我拿着这一头。别碰到画面。
text.en: Then hold this end for me. Don't touch the picture.

t.zh: 那你帮我拿着这一头。别碰到画面。
t.en: Then hold this end for me. Don't touch the picture.

t.zh: 我们一直修到天黑。她讲每一格的时候，声音比白天轻快很多。
t.en: We work until dark. When she talks about each frame, her voice is far lighter than it was by day.

t.zh: 潮声影院的放映室在银幕对面的小楼上。我推门进去的时候，季白正对着灯，一格一格地看胶片。
t.en: The Tidesound's projection booth is in the little building facing the screen. When I push the door open, Ji Bai is holding film up to the lamp, studying it frame by frame.

t.zh: 季白对你点了点头，客气得像对一个陌生人。
t.en: Ji Bai nods to you, as politely as she would to a stranger.

t.zh: 陆同学。墙上那些，是你祖父的字。
t.en: Mr. Lu. The writing on the wall there is your grandfather's.

t.zh: 墙上贴满了泛黄的便签：哪台机器哪天换过灯泡，哪部片子哪一卷容易断。最下面一张写着：“第七卷，别放。”
t.en: The wall is covered with yellowed notes: which machine had its bulb changed when, which reel of which film tends to snap. The one at the very bottom says: 'Reel seven. Don't run it.'

t.zh: 仓库里确实有一盘没有标签的胶片。我数过，它在第七个架子上。
t.en: There is a reel with no label in the storeroom. I counted. It's on the seventh shelf.

t.zh: 我一直没放。……因为他说别放。
t.en: I've never run it. …Because he said not to.

text.zh: 兄弟，你出名了。论坛上说转学生一来就到处追女生。
text.en: Buddy, you're famous. The forum says the new transfer has been chasing every girl in sight.

label.en: "…Got it."

text.zh: 这几天，路上遇见的人好像都在看我。
text.en: For days after, everyone I pass seems to be looking at me.

t.zh: 这几天，路上遇见的人好像都在看我。
t.en: For days after, everyone I pass seems to be looking at me.

t.zh: 兄弟，你出名了。论坛上说转学生一来就到处追女生。
t.en: Buddy, you're famous. The forum says the new transfer has been chasing every girl in sight.

t.zh: 我的建议是：这两天低调一点。
t.en: My advice: keep your head down for a couple of days.

text.zh: 周六傍晚。潮声影院的铁椅子被我们擦了一下午，还是锈的。
text.en: Saturday evening. We spent the whole afternoon wiping down the Tidesound's iron chairs. They're still rusty.

label.zh: 跑去放映室，帮季白接片。
label.en: Run to the booth and help Ji Bai splice the film.

text.zh: 按住这里。对，别抖。
text.en: Hold it here. Yes. Don't shake.

t.zh: 季白对你点了点头，客气得像对一个陌生人。
t.en: Ji Bai nods to you, as politely as she would to a stranger.

t.zh: 按住这里。对，别抖。
t.en: Hold it here. Yes. Don't shake.

t.zh: 她的手很稳。三分钟后，银幕重新亮了起来。
t.en: Her hands are steady. Three minutes later the screen lights up again.

t.zh: ……你的手，比我想的稳。
t.en: …Your hands are steadier than I expected.

label.zh: 跳上台，陪夏知遥对观众说话救场。
label.en: Jump onto the stage and help Zhiyao keep the audience.

text.zh: 各位，趁换片的时间，我们社长讲讲这部电影的幕后故事。
text.en: Everyone—while we change the reel, our president will tell you the story behind this film.

t.zh: 各位，趁换片的时间，我们社长讲讲这部电影的幕后故事。
t.en: Everyone—while we change the reel, our president will tell you the story behind this film.

t.zh: 我？！……好、好吧！这部片子拍的时候，导演其实——
t.en: Me?! …O-okay! When they shot this one, the director actually—

t.zh: 她讲得磕磕绊绊，可五个观众，一个都没走。
t.en: She stumbles through it, but of the five people watching, not one leaves.

t.zh: （小声）……谢了。
t.en: (quietly) …Thanks.

label.zh: 看见沈澄提着空保温桶往外走，追上去送她回家。
label.en: See Shen Cheng leaving with the empty flask, and walk her home.

text.zh: 不看完？
text.en: Not staying to the end?

t.zh: 不看完？
t.en: Not staying to the end?

t.zh: 断片了。正好。
t.en: The film broke. Good timing.

t.zh: ……你小时候，也总是电影放到一半就跑出来找我。
t.en: …When we were kids, you'd always run out halfway through a film to come find me.

t.zh: 一路上她没再说话。到了店门口，她说了声“晚安”，声音比白天软一点。
t.en: She doesn't say another word the whole way. At the café door she says 'good night,' a little softer than by day.

t.zh: 那天之后，我还是去填了表。夏知遥在教学楼门口堵了我三天。
t.en: In the end I filled in the form anyway. Xia Zhiyao staked out the lecture building for three days straight.

t.zh: 周六傍晚。潮声影院的铁椅子被我们擦了一下午，还是锈的。
t.en: Saturday evening. We spent the whole afternoon wiping down the Tidesound's iron chairs. They're still rusty.

t.zh: 你就是老陆的孙子？长得不像他。眼睛像。
t.en: So you're old Lu's grandson? You don't look like him. The eyes, maybe.

t.zh: 放映室的钥匙，你爷爷说过，哪天你回来了就给你。……喏。
t.en: Your grandfather said if you ever came back, I was to give you the booth key. …Here.

t.zh: 七点。来的人一共五个：两对情侣，一个遛狗的大爷。
t.en: Seven o'clock. Five people come in all: two couples and an old man walking his dog.

t.zh: 夏知遥看见你，把脸别了过去。那句话，她还记着。
t.en: Zhiyao sees you and turns her face away. She hasn't forgotten what you said.

t.zh: 五个人也是观众！春季放映会，第一场，开始！
t.en: Five people is still an audience! The Spring Screenings, first night—let's begin!

t.zh: 沈澄看了你一眼，又低下头去忙手里的事，一句话也没说。
t.en: Shen Cheng glances at you, then goes back to what she's doing without a word.

t.zh: ……我妈让我送的。热饮，给看电影的人。
t.en: …My mom told me to bring these. Hot drinks, for the audience.

t.zh: 热可可也有。棉花糖，只放了一块。
t.en: There's cocoa too. Only one marshmallow this time.

t.zh: 银幕亮了。海风把光吹得有点晃。放到一半，放映室那边传来一声闷响——画面停住，烧出一个白洞。
t.en: The screen lights up. The sea wind makes the light waver a little. Halfway through, a dull snap comes from the booth—the picture freezes and a white hole burns through it.

t.zh: 断片了……
t.en: The film broke…

t.zh: 夏知遥站在台上，从头到尾没有看你一眼。
t.en: Zhiyao stands on the stage and doesn't look at you once.

t.zh: 沈澄把热饮放下就走了，没有跟你打招呼。
t.en: Shen Cheng sets down the hot drinks and leaves without a word to you.

t.zh: 放映室的门关着。季白没有出来。
t.en: The booth door stays shut. Ji Bai doesn't come out.

text.zh: 活动室里，夏知遥对着一本账本算了很久。
text.en: In the club room, Xia Zhiyao has been staring at a ledger for a long time.

label.en: "Three thousand. We'll figure it out together."

text.zh: 你有办法？
text.en: You have a plan?

t.zh: 你有办法？
t.en: You have a plan?

t.zh: 老周说，放映室里有我爷爷的旧海报。拿去义卖。
t.en: Old Zhou says the booth is full of my grandfather's old posters. We sell them for charity.

t.zh: ……陆远，你偶尔还挺靠得住的嘛。
t.en: …Lu Yuan, you're actually reliable sometimes.

label.en: "That call just now—that was your mom, wasn't it?"

text.en: …Oh.

t.en: …Oh.

t.zh: 你眼睛真尖。没事，她就是想问我吃饭了没。
t.en: You've got sharp eyes. It's nothing. She just wanted to know if I'd eaten.

t.zh: 她把手机屏幕朝下扣在了桌上。
t.en: She sets the phone face down on the table.

t.zh: 活动室里，夏知遥对着一本账本算了很久。
t.en: In the club room, Xia Zhiyao has been staring at a ledger for a long time.

t.zh: 夏知遥看见你，把脸别了过去。那句话，她还记着。
t.en: Zhiyao sees you and turns her face away. She hasn't forgotten what you said.

t.zh: 租发电机、买胶片、印海报……最后一场想放得像样，至少要三千。
t.en: Generator rental, film stock, posters… if the last screening's going to look decent, we need three thousand at least.

t.zh: 她的手机响了。她看了一眼，按掉了。
t.en: Her phone rings. She glances at it and declines the call.

t.zh: ……推销电话。
t.en: …Telemarketer.

t.zh: 那个备注，写的是“妈”。
t.en: The contact name said 'Mom.'

text.zh: 夜里的海堤上，沈澄蹲着喂几只流浪猫。
text.en: On the seawall at night, Shen Cheng is crouched, feeding a few stray cats.

label.en: "…I'm sorry. I can't remember."

text.zh: 嗯。我猜也是。
text.en: Mm. I figured.

t.zh: 嗯。我猜也是。
t.en: Mm. I figured.

t.zh: 没关系。想不起来的话，就别硬想。……说出来就不算了。
t.en: It's fine. If you can't remember, don't force it. …If I tell you, it won't count.

label.en: "Of course I remember."

text.zh: 是吗。那你说说看。
text.en: Really? Then tell me.

t.zh: 是吗。那你说说看。
t.en: Really? Then tell me.

t.zh: 我说不出来。她站起来，拍了拍裙子上的灰。
t.en: I can't. She stands up and brushes the dust off her skirt.

t.zh: 撒谎的时候，你还是会摸耳朵。
t.en: You still touch your ear when you lie.

t.zh: 夜里的海堤上，沈澄蹲着喂几只流浪猫。
t.en: On the seawall at night, Shen Cheng is crouched, feeding a few stray cats.

t.zh: 它们是那只三花的孙子辈。你走的那年，它刚生。
t.en: They're the grandkids of that calico. The year you left, she'd just had her litter.

t.zh: 沈澄看了你一眼，又低下头去忙手里的事，一句话也没说。
t.en: Shen Cheng glances at you, then goes back to what she's doing without a word.

t.zh: ……你走的那天，你说过一句话。你还记得吗？
t.en: …The day you left, you said something to me. Do you remember?

t.zh: 我拼命地想。只想得起那天下雨，站台上很多人。
t.en: I search my memory as hard as I can. All I recall is that it rained, and the platform was crowded.

text.zh: 图书馆三楼最里面，季白在翻一本很旧的胶片修复手册。
text.en: On the library's third floor, in the farthest corner, Ji Bai is leafing through a very old film-restoration manual.

label.zh: 讲小时候爷爷带你在放映室过夜的事。
label.en: Tell her how your grandfather let you spend nights in the booth as a kid.

text.zh: ……原来放映室那张小床，是给你的。
text.en: …So the little cot in the booth was for you.

t.zh: ……原来放映室那张小床，是给你的。
t.en: …So the little cot in the booth was for you.

t.zh: 我一直以为，是给他自己的。
t.en: I always assumed it was his.

label.zh: “你为什么这么在意那盘胶片？”
label.en: "Why do you care so much about that reel?"

text.zh: ……因为它是唯一一盘，我不知道里面是什么的。
text.en: …Because it's the only reel I don't know the contents of.

t.zh: ……因为它是唯一一盘，我不知道里面是什么的。
t.en: …Because it's the only reel I don't know the contents of.

t.zh: 修胶片的人，最怕的就是这个。
t.en: For someone who restores film, that's the most frightening thing there is.

t.zh: 图书馆三楼最里面，季白在翻一本很旧的胶片修复手册。
t.en: On the library's third floor, in the farthest corner, Ji Bai is leafing through a very old film-restoration manual.

t.zh: 季白对你点了点头，客气得像对一个陌生人。
t.en: Ji Bai nods to you, as politely as she would to a stranger.

t.zh: 陆同学。你祖父……是个什么样的人？
t.en: Mr. Lu. What was your grandfather like?

t.zh: 我修他的胶片两年了。每一盘的接缝都整整齐齐，只有一盘，接得乱七八糟。像是手在抖。
t.en: I've been restoring his film for two years. Every splice is perfectly neat—except on one reel. That one's a mess. As if his hands were shaking.

t.zh: 第七卷。那盘没有标签的。
t.en: Reel seven. The one with no label.

text.zh: 四月初，学生处来了通知：电影社月底前凑不齐三个人，就撤销，影院的场地使用证明也一起作废。
text.en: Early April, a notice from Student Affairs: if the film club doesn't have three members by month's end, it's dissolved—and its permit to use the cinema goes with it.

label.en: Go ask Ji Bai in the booth.

text.zh: 我？我说过，我不是社员。
text.en: Me? I told you, I'm not a member.

t.zh: 季白对你点了点头，客气得像对一个陌生人。
t.en: Ji Bai nods to you, as politely as she would to a stranger.

t.zh: 我？我说过，我不是社员。
t.en: Me? I told you, I'm not a member.

t.zh: 现在开始是。你修了两年它的胶片，它的最后一场，你不在名单上，说不过去。
t.en: Starting now, you are. You've spent two years restoring its film. It wouldn't be right if your name wasn't on the list for its last show.

t.zh: ……你很会说话。
t.en: …You're good with words.

t.zh: 好。不过放映员的活儿，我照样要拿工钱。
t.en: Fine. But I still expect to be paid for the projection work.

label.en: Go ask Shen Cheng at the café.

text.zh: 电影社？
text.en: The film club?

t.zh: 沈澄看了你一眼，又低下头去忙手里的事，一句话也没说。
t.en: Shen Cheng glances at you, then goes back to what she's doing without a word.

t.zh: 电影社？
t.en: The film club?

t.zh: ……潮声影院的最后一场，我本来就要去的。
t.en: …I was going to be at the Tidesound's last show anyway.

t.zh: 表给我。
t.en: Give me the form.

t.zh: 她填表的时候，把我的名字那一栏看了很久。
t.en: As she fills it in, she looks at the line with my name on it for a long time.

hint.en: She won't give you the time of day yet

label.en: Drag your roommate Cheng Hang in to make up the numbers.

text.zh: 电影社？女生多吗？——三个？！而且都……兄弟，我入了！
text.en: The film club? Lots of girls?—Three of them?! And they're all… Buddy, I'm in!

t.zh: 电影社？女生多吗？——三个？！而且都……兄弟，我入了！
t.en: The film club? Lots of girls?—Three of them?! And they're all… Buddy, I'm in!

t.zh: ……陆远，你就找了这么个人？
t.en: …Lu Yuan, this is who you found?

t.zh: 算了，能签字就行。
t.en: Fine. As long as he can sign his name.

t.zh: 四月初，学生处来了通知：电影社月底前凑不齐三个人，就撤销，影院的场地使用证明也一起作废。
t.en: Early April, a notice from Student Affairs: if the film club doesn't have three members by month's end, it's dissolved—and its permit to use the cinema goes with it.

t.zh: 夏知遥看见你，把脸别了过去。那句话，她还记着。
t.en: Zhiyao sees you and turns her face away. She hasn't forgotten what you said.

t.zh: 还差一个。就差一个。
t.en: One more. Just one more.

t.zh: 义卖的钱够了，可是没有人，钱也没用。
t.en: The poster sale raised the money—but without members, money's no use.

t.zh: 陆远，你帮我去问一个人。谁都行。
t.en: Lu Yuan, go ask someone for me. Anyone.

t.zh: 她说话的时候，一直看着别处。
t.en: The whole time she talks, she looks somewhere else.

text.zh: 中午，夏知遥拉我上了教学楼天台。她带了两个饭团。
text.en: At noon Xia Zhiyao drags me up to the roof of the teaching building. She's brought two rice balls.

label.en: "What about you?"

text.zh: 我啊……
text.en: Me…

t.zh: 我啊……
t.en: Me…

t.zh: 我要回家了。我妈一个人，身体不太好。
t.en: I'm going home. My mom's on her own, and her health isn't great.

t.zh: 所以影院的最后一场，也是我的最后一场。……别告诉别人。
t.en: So the cinema's last show is my last show too. …Don't tell anyone.

label.en: "Depends on whether you do."

text.en: …Hmph.

t.en: …Hmph.

t.zh: 笨蛋。饭团要掉了。
t.en: Idiot. You're about to drop your rice ball.

t.zh: 中午，夏知遥拉我上了教学楼天台。她带了两个饭团。
t.en: At noon Xia Zhiyao drags me up to the roof of the teaching building. She's brought two rice balls.

t.zh: 夏知遥看见你，把脸别了过去。那句话，她还记着。
t.en: Zhiyao sees you and turns her face away. She hasn't forgotten what you said.

t.zh: 从这里能看见潮声影院的银幕。看，那个白点。
t.en: You can see the Tidesound's screen from here. Look—that white dot.

t.zh: ……陆远，毕业以后，你会留在汐川吗？
t.en: …Lu Yuan, after graduation—will you stay in Xichuan?

t.zh: 我想起那个被她按掉的电话。
t.en: I think of the call she declined.

text.zh: 打烊以后，沈澄把一张照片推到我面前。照片上是两个小孩，坐在潮声影院的第一排。
text.en: After closing, Shen Cheng slides a photo across to me. Two kids, sitting in the front row of the Tidesound.

label.en: "This time, I'll keep my word."

text.zh: ……七年才兑现的约，算吗？
text.en: …Does a promise count if it takes seven years?

t.zh: ……七年才兑现的约，算吗？
t.en: …Does a promise count if it takes seven years?

t.zh: 算吧。
t.en: I suppose it does.

label.en: "I'm sorry I made you wait so long."

text.zh: 我没在等。
text.en: I wasn't waiting.

t.zh: 我没在等。
t.en: I wasn't waiting.

t.zh: ……只是每年春天，都会去看一眼影院还在不在。
t.en: …I just went to check every spring whether the cinema was still there.

t.zh: 打烊以后，沈澄把一张照片推到我面前。照片上是两个小孩，坐在潮声影院的第一排。
t.en: After closing, Shen Cheng slides a photo across to me. Two kids, sitting in the front row of the Tidesound.

t.zh: 沈澄看了你一眼，又低下头去忙手里的事，一句话也没说。
t.en: Shen Cheng glances at you, then goes back to what she's doing without a word.

t.zh: 这是你走之前一个月拍的。你爷爷拍的。
t.en: This was taken a month before you left. Your grandfather took it.

t.zh: 我想起来了。那天放的是一部很老的片子，我睡着了，醒来的时候，她在哭。
t.en: I remember now. They were showing a very old film, I fell asleep, and when I woke up she was crying.

t.zh: 你那天说：“等这座影院要关的时候，最后一场，我一定回来陪你看。”
t.en: That day you said: 'When this cinema closes, I'll come back for its last show. I'll watch it with you. I promise.'

text.zh: 影院仓库里很暗。季白站在第七个架子前面，手里拿着那盘胶片。
text.en: The cinema's storeroom is dark. Ji Bai stands before the seventh shelf with the reel in her hands.

label.en: "Before the last show, we'll watch it together."

text.zh: ……一起？
text.en: …Together?

t.zh: ……一起？
t.en: …Together?

t.zh: 好。那我先把它修好。一格都不会少。
t.en: All right. Then I'll restore it first. Not a single frame missing.

label.en: "He said not to run it. So let's not."

text.en: …Mm.

t.en: …Mm.

t.zh: 她把胶片放回了架子上，动作很轻，像放下一个睡着的人。
t.en: She sets the reel back on the shelf, gently, like laying down someone asleep.

t.zh: 影院仓库里很暗。季白站在第七个架子前面，手里拿着那盘胶片。
t.en: The cinema's storeroom is dark. Ji Bai stands before the seventh shelf with the reel in her hands.

t.zh: 季白对你点了点头，客气得像对一个陌生人。
t.en: Ji Bai nods to you, as politely as she would to a stranger.

t.zh: 影院拆了，这盘胶片就没有地方放了。
t.en: Once the cinema's gone, there'll be nowhere left to run this reel.

t.zh: 陆同学，你是他的孙子。放不放，应该你来定。
t.en: Mr. Lu, you're his grandson. Whether it gets run should be your decision.

title.en: The Night Before the Last Show

text.zh: 四月最后一个周五。明天，是潮声影院的最后一场放映。下周一，拆迁队就会进场。
text.en: The last Friday of April. Tomorrow is the Tidesound Cinema's final screening. Next Monday, the demolition crew moves in.

label.zh: 去银幕下面。夏知遥一定还在排练。
label.en: Go to the stage below the screen. Zhiyao will still be rehearsing.

text.zh: ……你来了。
text.en: …You came.

t.zh: 夏知遥看见你，把脸别了过去。那句话，她还记着。
t.en: Zhiyao sees you and turns her face away. She hasn't forgotten what you said.

t.zh: ……你来了。
t.en: …You came.

t.zh: 我一个人练了一晚上开场白。每次念到“最后一季”，就念不下去。
t.en: I've been practicing the opening speech all night on my own. Every time I get to 'final season,' I can't go on.

t.zh: 你知道的。这也是我的最后一季。
t.en: You know why. It's my final season too.

label.zh: 去海堤。沈澄说过，她每年春天都会去看影院还在不在。
label.en: Go to the seawall. Shen Cheng said she checks every spring that the cinema's still there.

text.zh: ……我就知道。
text.en: …I knew it.

t.zh: 沈澄看了你一眼，又低下头去忙手里的事，一句话也没说。
t.en: Shen Cheng glances at you, then goes back to what she's doing without a word.

t.zh: ……我就知道。
t.en: …I knew it.

t.zh: 明天。七年前你说的那一场，就是明天。
t.en: Tomorrow. The show you promised seven years ago—it's tomorrow.

t.zh: 社员证我带着。明天我坐第一排，你别想跑。
t.en: I've got my membership card. I'm sitting in the front row tomorrow, so don't you dare run off.

label.en: Go to the booth. The light's still on.

text.zh: 我修好了。第七卷。……要看吗？
text.en: I've finished it. Reel seven. …Do you want to see it?

t.zh: 季白对你点了点头，客气得像对一个陌生人。
t.en: Ji Bai nods to you, as politely as she would to a stranger.

t.zh: 我修好了。第七卷。……要看吗？
t.en: I've finished it. Reel seven. …Do you want to see it?

t.zh: 你说过，要一起看。我一个人的时候，一格都没看。
t.en: You said we'd watch it together. On my own, I haven't looked at a single frame.

t.zh: 做了社员以后，我第一次有了放映室的钥匙。……今晚，我想用它。
t.en: Since becoming a member, I have my own key to the booth for the first time. …Tonight I wanted to use it.

label.zh: 回老房子。明天还要早起。
label.en: Go back to the old house. It's an early start tomorrow.

text.zh: 院子里的枇杷树沙沙地响。我躺在小时候的床上，听了一夜的海。
text.en: The loquat tree rustles in the yard. I lie in my childhood bed and listen to the sea all night.

t.zh: 院子里的枇杷树沙沙地响。我躺在小时候的床上，听了一夜的海。
t.en: The loquat tree rustles in the yard. I lie in my childhood bed and listen to the sea all night.

t.zh: 四月最后一个周五。明天，是潮声影院的最后一场放映。下周一，拆迁队就会进场。
t.en: The last Friday of April. Tomorrow is the Tidesound Cinema's final screening. Next Monday, the demolition crew moves in.

t.zh: 海报贴满了半个汐川。夏知遥说，明天至少会来两百个人。
t.en: Posters cover half of Xichuan. Zhiyao says at least two hundred people will come tomorrow.

t.zh: 海报最上面印着一行字：“来看它最后一个春天。”——是我第一天在这里说的话。
t.en: Across the top of every poster is one line: 'Come see its last spring.' The words I said here on my first day.

t.zh: 两百个？我在论坛上发了帖，保底三百。别谢我，谢我的号召力。
t.en: Two hundred? I posted on the forum. Three hundred, minimum. Don't thank me—thank my reach.

t.zh: 你爷爷要是看见了，得哭。
t.en: If your grandfather could see this, he'd cry.

t.zh: 去吧。今晚，总有人在等你。
t.en: Go on. Tonight, someone's bound to be waiting for you.

t.zh: 今晚，我想去见的是——
t.en: Tonight, the one I want to see is—

text.zh: 晚上六点半，铁椅子坐满了。后来的人站在最后一排后面，再后来的人，坐到了海堤上。
text.en: Six-thirty in the evening, and every iron seat is taken. Latecomers stand behind the back row; the ones after them sit along the seawall.

label.en: Walk up onto the stage and stand beside her.

text.zh: ……陆远？
text.en: …Lu Yuan?

t.zh: ……你真的来了。拉过钩的。
t.en: …You really came. We pinky swore.

t.zh: ……陆远？
t.en: …Lu Yuan?

t.zh: 我们社长有点激动。下面这句，我们一起念。
t.en: Our president's a little emotional. We'll say this next part together.

t.zh: 她看了我一眼，深吸一口气。
t.en: She glances at me and takes a deep breath.

t.zh: ……春季放映会，最后一季。第一部——开始！
t.en: …The Spring Screenings, final season. Our first film—let's begin!

t.zh: 台下的掌声，比海浪还响。
t.en: The applause is louder than the waves.

label.zh: 在台下，把她第一天说的那句话喊回给她。
label.en: From the crowd, shout her own words from that first day back at her.

text.zh: 社长！五个人也是观众——今天有三百个！
text.en: President! Five people is still an audience—tonight there are three hundred!

t.zh: 社长！五个人也是观众——今天有三百个！
t.en: President! Five people is still an audience—tonight there are three hundred!

t.zh: 台下哄地笑了。有人跟着喊：“开始！开始！”
t.en: The crowd bursts out laughing. Someone starts chanting: 'Begin! Begin!'

t.zh: ……笨蛋。
t.en: …Idiot.

t.zh: 那就——春季放映会，最后一季，开始！
t.en: Then—the Spring Screenings, final season, let's begin!

label.zh: 跑去放映室，让季白先开机，用画面替她解围。
label.en: Run to the booth and have Ji Bai start the projector, to get her off the hook.

text.zh: 光从我头顶射出去，银幕亮了。台下安静下来。
text.en: Light shoots out over my head and the screen comes alive. The crowd falls quiet.

t.zh: 光从我头顶射出去，银幕亮了。台下安静下来。
t.en: Light shoots out over my head and the screen comes alive. The crowd falls quiet.

t.zh: 等我回到台下，夏知遥已经不在台上了。她坐在最边上的位置，一直看着银幕，没有看我。
t.en: By the time I get back down, Zhiyao has left the stage. She's sitting in the seat at the very end of a row, eyes fixed on the screen. She doesn't look at me.

label.zh: 跑去放映室，让季白先开机，用画面替她解围。
label.en: Run to the booth and have Ji Bai start the projector, to get her off the hook.

text.zh: 光从我头顶射出去，银幕亮了。台下安静下来。
text.en: Light shoots out over my head and the screen comes alive. The crowd falls quiet.

t.zh: 光从我头顶射出去，银幕亮了。台下安静下来。
t.en: Light shoots out over my head and the screen comes alive. The crowd falls quiet.

t.zh: 等我回到台下，夏知遥已经不在台上了。她坐在最边上的位置，一直看着银幕，没有看我。
t.en: By the time I get back down, Zhiyao has left the stage. She's sitting in the seat at the very end of a row, eyes fixed on the screen. She doesn't look at me.

t.zh: ……我答应过她，要站在她身边的。
t.en: …I promised her I'd stand beside her.

t.zh: 散场的时候，她只说了一句：“拉过钩的。”
t.en: When the show ends, she says only one thing: 'We pinky swore.'

t.zh: 晚上六点半，铁椅子坐满了。后来的人站在最后一排后面，再后来的人，坐到了海堤上。
t.en: Six-thirty in the evening, and every iron seat is taken. Latecomers stand behind the back row; the ones after them sit along the seawall.

t.zh: 三百二十七个。我数了两遍。
t.en: Three hundred and twenty-seven. I counted twice.

t.zh: 老周坐在第一排正中间。那是爷爷以前的位置。
t.en: Old Zhou sits dead center in the front row. It used to be my grandfather's seat.

t.zh: 七点整。夏知遥走上台，拿起话筒。
t.en: Seven o'clock sharp. Xia Zhiyao walks onto the stage and picks up the microphone.

t.zh: 夏知遥看见你，把脸别了过去。那句话，她还记着。
t.en: Zhiyao sees you and turns her face away. She hasn't forgotten what you said.

t.zh: 各位晚上好。欢迎来到潮声影院，春季放映会——
t.en: Good evening, everyone. Welcome to the Tidesound Cinema, and to the Spring Screenings—

t.zh: ……最后、
t.en: …final—

t.zh: 她停住了。三百个人在等。海风把她手里的稿子吹得哗哗响。
t.en: She stops. Three hundred people wait. The sea wind rattles the pages in her hand.

t.zh: 我知道她为什么念不下去。这是影院的最后一季，也是她的。
t.en: I know why she can't go on. It's the cinema's final season, and hers too.

t.zh: 得做点什么。
t.en: I have to do something.

text.zh: 最后一部电影的最后一个镜头，是一片海。银幕上的海，和银幕后面的海，连在了一起。
text.en: The last shot of the last film is the sea. The sea on the screen and the sea behind it run together into one.

label.zh: “那这一周，你想做的事，我们全做完。”
label.en: "Then this week, everything you want to do—we'll do it all."

text.zh: ……你是听不懂人话吗。
text.en: …Do you not understand plain words?

t.zh: ……你是听不懂人话吗。
t.en: …Do you not understand plain words?

t.zh: 毕业前想做的事，我列过一张单子。十件。……你可别后悔。
t.en: I made a list once. Things to do before graduating. Ten of them. …Don't you dare regret this.

label.en: "Then I'll go back with you."

text.zh: ……你说什么傻话。
text.en: …What kind of stupid thing is that to say?

t.zh: ……你说什么傻话。
t.en: …What kind of stupid thing is that to say?

t.zh: 你才刚回到汐川。老房子、影院、你爷爷留下的东西……你又要为了别人，走一次？
t.en: You've only just come back to Xichuan. The old house, the cinema, everything your grandfather left… and you'd leave again, for someone else?

t.zh: 她跳下台，往门口走。走到一半，停了一下。
t.en: She hops down from the stage and heads for the gate. Halfway there, she stops.

t.zh: ……谢谢。可是不行。
t.en: …Thank you. But no.

label.en: "…All right."

text.zh: 嗯。这样最好。
text.en: Mm. It's better this way.

t.zh: 嗯。这样最好。
t.en: Mm. It's better this way.

t.zh: 她笑得很好看。好看得不像真的。
t.en: Her smile is lovely. Too lovely to be real.

t.zh: 最后一部电影的最后一个镜头，是一片海。银幕上的海，和银幕后面的海，连在了一起。
t.en: The last shot of the last film is the sea. The sea on the screen and the sea behind it run together into one.

t.zh: 人走光了。夏知遥坐在台边，两只脚悬在半空。
t.en: Everyone has gone. Zhiyao sits on the edge of the stage, feet dangling over the side.

t.zh: 夏知遥看见你，把脸别了过去。那句话，她还记着。
t.en: Zhiyao sees you and turns her face away. She hasn't forgotten what you said.

t.zh: 三百二十七个人。……我也数了。
t.en: Three hundred and twenty-seven people. …I counted too.

t.zh: 陆远。下周六，我坐早上那班车回家。
t.en: Lu Yuan. Next Saturday I'm taking the morning train home.

t.zh: 我妈下个月做手术。家里只有她一个人。……这件事，我一直没跟社里说。
t.en: My mom has surgery next month. She's on her own at home. …I never told anyone in the club.

t.zh: 你早就知道了。那天在天台上，我只告诉了你一个人。
t.en: You knew already. That day on the roof, you were the only one I told.

t.zh: 所以啊，这一周，你别对我太好。不然我走的时候，会哭得很难看的。
t.en: So this week—don't be too nice to me. Otherwise when I leave, I'll cry, and it won't be pretty.

text.zh: 周一早上，挖掘机停在了影院门口。工人们先拆的是铁椅子，一排一排，叮叮当当。
text.en: Monday morning, an excavator pulls up at the cinema gate. The workers take the iron seats out first, row by row, clanging.

label.zh: 爬上架子，帮她剪下右下角那一块。
label.en: Climb the scaffold and cut the bottom-right corner for her.

text.zh: 银幕的布比想象中厚。剪下来的那一块上，有一道淡淡的水渍，像一朵云。
text.en: The canvas is thicker than I expected. On the piece that comes away there's a faint water stain, shaped like a cloud.

t.zh: 银幕的布比想象中厚。剪下来的那一块上，有一道淡淡的水渍，像一朵云。
t.en: The canvas is thicker than I expected. On the piece that comes away there's a faint water stain, shaped like a cloud.

t.zh: ……这是我大一第一次来的时候，下雨淋的。我记得。
t.en: …That's from the rain the first time I came here, freshman year. I remember.

t.zh: 谢谢你。偏偏是这一块。
t.en: Thank you. Of all the pieces, it was this one.

label.zh: “剪下来以后，社员都在背面签个名。”
label.en: "Once it's cut, let's have every member sign the back."

text.zh: 背面是灰色的。我们用马克笔，一个一个签上去。
text.en: The back is grey. We sign it one by one, in marker.

t.zh: 背面是灰色的。我们用马克笔，一个一个签上去。
t.en: The back is grey. We sign it one by one, in marker.

t.zh: 季白签得最工整，像印上去的。
t.en: Ji Bai's signature is the neatest, as if it were printed.

t.zh: 沈澄签完，在旁边画了一只三花猫。
t.en: Shen Cheng signs, then draws a calico cat beside her name.

t.zh: 程航签了一个最大的名字，占了半块布。
t.en: Cheng Hang signs the biggest name of all. It takes up half the cloth.

t.zh: 好丑。
t.en: It's hideous.

t.zh: ……我会好好挂起来的。
t.en: …I'll hang it up properly.

label.zh: “我去和拆迁队商量，银幕晚两天再拆。”
label.en: "I'll talk to the demolition crew. Get them to leave the screen two more days."

text.zh: ……你这个人，总想把什么都留住。
text.en: …You always want to hold on to everything, don't you.

t.zh: ……你这个人，总想把什么都留住。
t.en: …You always want to hold on to everything, don't you.

t.zh: 可是留不住的。早一天，晚一天，都一样。
t.en: But you can't. A day earlier, a day later—it's all the same.

t.zh: 周一早上，挖掘机停在了影院门口。工人们先拆的是铁椅子，一排一排，叮叮当当。
t.en: Monday morning, an excavator pulls up at the cinema gate. The workers take the iron seats out first, row by row, clanging.

t.zh: 银幕留到最后拆。那块布，是你爷爷一针一针缝的。
t.en: The screen comes down last. Your grandfather sewed that canvas himself, stitch by stitch.

t.zh: 夏知遥看见你，把脸别了过去。那句话，她还记着。
t.en: Zhiyao sees you and turns her face away. She hasn't forgotten what you said.

t.zh: 单子上第一件：从银幕上剪一块布带走。工人叔叔同意了，就一小块。
t.en: First thing on the list: cut a piece off the screen to take with me. The workers said yes—just a small piece.

t.zh: ……那天晚上的话，我就当没听见。
t.en: …What you said that night—I'm pretending I didn't hear it.

t.zh: 陆远。早。
t.en: Lu Yuan. Morning.

t.zh: 我想要一小块银幕。带回家，挂在我妈的病房里。她第一次看电影，也是在这里。
t.en: I want a little piece of the screen. To take home and hang in my mom's hospital room. The first film she ever saw was here, too.

text.zh: 周三下午，没有课。夏知遥拉我到了海边，手里攥着那张单子。
text.en: Wednesday afternoon, no classes. Zhiyao drags me down to the beach, the list clutched in her hand.

label.zh: 对着海喊：“汐川——我回来了！”
label.en: Shout at the sea: "Xichuan—I'm back!"

text.zh: 喊完，嗓子都哑了。几只海鸥被吓飞了。
text.en: When I'm done my throat is raw. A few gulls take off in fright.

t.zh: 喊完，嗓子都哑了。几只海鸥被吓飞了。
t.en: When I'm done my throat is raw. A few gulls take off in fright.

t.zh: 到我了。
t.en: My turn.
I—don't—want—to—go!

t.zh: 海浪把她的声音卷走了。她站了很久，然后转过身来，眼睛红红的，笑了。
t.en: The waves carry her voice away. She stands there a long time, then turns around, eyes red, and smiles.

t.zh: ……好了。说完了。你就当没听见。
t.en: …There. Done. Pretend you didn't hear that.

label.en: "Let's skip number seven. It's silly."

text.zh: ……也是。
text.en: …I guess.

t.zh: ……也是。
t.en: …I guess.

t.zh: 她把单子折起来，放回口袋。那天下午，我们只是沿着海边走了一圈。
t.en: She folds the list and puts it back in her pocket. That afternoon, we just walk the length of the shore.

t.zh: 周三下午，没有课。夏知遥拉我到了海边，手里攥着那张单子。
t.en: Wednesday afternoon, no classes. Zhiyao drags me down to the beach, the list clutched in her hand.

t.zh: 夏知遥看见你，把脸别了过去。那句话，她还记着。
t.en: Zhiyao sees you and turns her face away. She hasn't forgotten what you said.

t.zh: 第七件：对着海，喊一句平时不敢说的话。
t.en: Number seven: shout something at the sea that you'd never dare say out loud.

t.zh: ……单子是我自己的。今天突然想做，就叫上你了。
t.en: …It's my own list. I just felt like doing it today, so I called you.

t.zh: 你先。
t.en: You first.

text.zh: 活动室已经空了一半。夏知遥一边装箱，一边接起了视频电话。这一次，她没有按掉。
text.en: The club room is half empty. Zhiyao is packing boxes when a video call comes in. This time, she doesn't decline it.

label.zh: 跟阿姨讲周六那晚，她在三百个人面前念开场白。
label.en: Tell her mother about Saturday night—her daughter's opening speech in front of three hundred people.

text.zh: 我讲完，屏幕那头安静了一会儿。
text.en: When I finish, the other end of the line is quiet for a moment.

t.zh: 我讲完，屏幕那头安静了一会儿。
t.en: When I finish, the other end of the line is quiet for a moment.

t.zh: “她小时候就爱站在台上。”阿姨说，“我生病以后，她就不站了。谢谢你，让她又站上去了。”
t.en: 'She always loved being on a stage when she was little,' her mother says. 'After I got sick, she stopped. Thank you for getting her back up there.'

t.zh: 妈！……你别乱说。
t.en: Mom! …Don't say things like that.

label.zh: 规规矩矩地问好，说社团会把那块银幕寄到医院。
label.en: Greet her politely, and say the club will send the piece of screen to the hospital.

text.zh: “这孩子真懂事。”阿姨说，“知遥这个人嘴硬，你多担待。”
text.en: 'What a thoughtful young man,' her mother says. 'Zhiyao's all bark—be patient with her.'

t.zh: “这孩子真懂事。”阿姨说，“知遥这个人嘴硬，你多担待。”
t.en: 'What a thoughtful young man,' her mother says. 'Zhiyao's all bark—be patient with her.'

t.zh: ……我挂了！
t.en: …I'm hanging up!

t.zh: 活动室已经空了一半。夏知遥一边装箱，一边接起了视频电话。这一次，她没有按掉。
t.en: The club room is half empty. Zhiyao is packing boxes when a video call comes in. This time, she doesn't decline it.

t.zh: 夏知遥看见你，把脸别了过去。那句话，她还记着。
t.en: Zhiyao sees you and turns her face away. She hasn't forgotten what you said.

t.zh: 妈。嗯，吃了。……这个？这是社员。
t.en: Mom. Yeah, I ate. …Him? He's a club member.

t.zh: 她把手机转过来对着我。屏幕里的阿姨很瘦，笑起来和她一模一样。
t.en: She turns the phone toward me. The woman on the screen is very thin, and when she smiles she looks exactly like her daughter.

title.en: The White Dot That Isn't There

text.zh: 中午，我们又上了天台。她还是带了两个饭团。
text.en: At noon we go up to the roof again. She's brought two rice balls, as always.

label.zh: “那我每周六拍一张汐川的海，发给你。”
label.en: "Then every Saturday I'll take a photo of the sea here and send it to you."

text.zh: ……每周？
text.en: …Every week?

t.zh: ……每周？
t.en: …Every week?

t.zh: 说好了。少一周，我就把你从社员名单上删掉。
t.en: It's a deal. Miss one week and I'm striking you off the membership list.

label.zh: 什么也不说，陪她坐着，把饭团吃完。
label.en: Say nothing. Sit with her and finish the rice balls.

text.zh: 风很大。吃到一半，她把头轻轻靠在了我的肩膀上。
text.en: It's windy. Halfway through, she leans her head lightly against my shoulder.

t.zh: 风很大。吃到一半，她把头轻轻靠在了我的肩膀上。
t.en: It's windy. Halfway through, she leans her head lightly against my shoulder.

t.zh: ……就一会儿。
t.en: …Just for a minute.

t.zh: 中午，我们又上了天台。她还是带了两个饭团。
t.en: At noon we go up to the roof again. She's brought two rice balls, as always.

t.zh: 夏知遥看见你，把脸别了过去。那句话，她还记着。
t.en: Zhiyao sees you and turns her face away. She hasn't forgotten what you said.

t.zh: 你看，那个白点不见了。
t.en: Look. The white dot's gone.

t.zh: 以后我在家里，往南边看，什么都看不见了。
t.en: When I'm home, I'll look south and there'll be nothing to see.

text.zh: 她走的前一晚，下雨了。夏知遥抱着一个纸箱，站在校门口的公交站下面。
text.en: The night before she leaves, it rains. Zhiyao stands under the bus shelter by the school gate, hugging a cardboard box.

label.zh: “我留下来。明年春天，我在汐川重新放电影。”
label.en: "I'm staying. Next spring, I'll start showing films in Xichuan again."

text.zh: ……没有影院了。
text.en: …There's no cinema anymore.

t.zh: ……没有影院了。
t.en: …There's no cinema anymore.

t.zh: 有海堤。有银幕。季白说，那台旧放映机还能转。
t.en: There's the seawall. There's a screen. Ji Bai says the old projector still runs.

t.zh: 银幕少了右下角一块。正好，等它回来补上。
t.en: The screen's missing its bottom-right corner. Fine. It can be stitched back in when it comes home.

t.zh: ……背面还有大家的名字呢。可不许弄丢。
t.en: …It's got everyone's names on the back. Don't you dare lose it.

t.zh: ……那你给我留个位置。
t.en: …Then save me a seat.

t.zh: 第一排。正中间。
t.en: Front row. Dead center.

label.zh: 把伞给她，陪她走回宿舍。
label.en: Give her your umbrella and walk her back to her dorm.

text.zh: 伞不大。我们一路没说话，雨落在我的半边肩膀上。
text.en: The umbrella isn't big. We don't say a word the whole way, and the rain falls on one of my shoulders.

t.zh: 伞不大。我们一路没说话，雨落在我的半边肩膀上。
t.en: The umbrella isn't big. We don't say a word the whole way, and the rain falls on one of my shoulders.

t.zh: ……你半边都湿了，笨蛋。
t.en: …Half of you is soaked, you idiot.

label.en: "Go home and take care of your mom. Don't look back."

text.en: …Mm.

t.en: …Mm.

t.zh: 车来了。她抱着纸箱上了车，真的一次也没有回头。
t.en: The bus comes. She climbs on with the box in her arms, and she really doesn't look back, not once.

t.zh: 她走的前一晚，下雨了。夏知遥抱着一个纸箱，站在校门口的公交站下面。
t.en: The night before she leaves, it rains. Zhiyao stands under the bus shelter by the school gate, hugging a cardboard box.

t.zh: 夏知遥看见你，把脸别了过去。那句话，她还记着。
t.en: Zhiyao sees you and turns her face away. She hasn't forgotten what you said.

t.zh: 这一周，你真的没来找我。……我是不是很奇怪，明明是我让你别来的。
t.en: You really didn't come looking for me all week. …Isn't it strange? I'm the one who told you not to.

t.zh: 社团的东西，都在这里了。钥匙给你。
t.en: Everything from the club is in here. Here's the key.

t.zh: 陆远，电影社以后就是你的了。
t.en: Lu Yuan, the film club's yours now.

t.zh: ……其实我一直想问。你说回汐川，是为了看它最后一个春天。那看完了以后呢？
t.en: …There's something I've always wanted to ask. You said you came back to Xichuan to see its last spring. What about after?

text.zh: 早上七点的汐川站，只有一个站台。和我回来的那天一样。
text.en: Seven in the morning, and Xichuan Station has only one platform. Just like the day I came back.

label.zh: “夏知遥。我喜欢你。……所以明年春天，回来看我放的第一场。”
label.en: "Xia Zhiyao. I like you. …So next spring, come back and watch my first show."

text.en: …Huh?

t.en: …Huh?

t.zh: 笨蛋。为什么偏偏现在才说。
t.en: Idiot. Why did you have to wait until now to say it?

t.zh: 她跳上车门的台阶，又转过身来。眼泪掉下来了，可她在笑。
t.en: She steps up into the doorway of the train, then turns back. The tears are falling, but she's smiling.

t.zh: ……我也是。第一排，给我留着。
t.en: …Me too. Save me that front-row seat.

t.zh: 车门关上了。列车开走的时候，她一直把手贴在窗户上。
t.en: The doors close. As the train pulls away, she keeps her hand pressed to the window.

label.en: Wave: "Have a safe trip."

text.zh: 嗯。你也是。
text.en: Mm. You too.

t.zh: 嗯。你也是。
t.en: Mm. You too.

t.zh: 她笑着挥手，上了车。列车拐过海湾，看不见了。
t.en: She waves, smiling, and boards. The train rounds the bay and is gone.

t.zh: 直到那时我才想起来：七年前，我也是这样，什么都没说。
t.en: Only then does it hit me: seven years ago, I said nothing either. Just like this.

t.zh: 早上七点的汐川站，只有一个站台。和我回来的那天一样。
t.en: Seven in the morning, and Xichuan Station has only one platform. Just like the day I came back.

t.zh: 花已经谢了。树上全是新叶子。
t.en: The blossoms have fallen. The trees are all new leaves.

t.zh: 夏知遥看见你，把脸别了过去。那句话，她还记着。
t.en: Zhiyao sees you and turns her face away. She hasn't forgotten what you said.

t.zh: ……你来了。我以为你不会来。
t.en: …You came. I thought you wouldn't.

t.zh: 第一天在影院，你看见我对着空椅子念宣传词……你说你记得。我也记得你那天的表情。
t.en: That first day at the cinema, you saw me reading to empty seats… you said you remembered. I remember your face that day, too.

t.zh: 喂。来送我啊？
t.en: Hey. Come to see me off?

t.zh: 那块银幕，我放在箱子最上面了。
t.en: That piece of screen—I put it right on top in my suitcase.

t.zh: 我妈说，下次让你去家里吃饭。……你别当真啊！
t.en: My mom says you should come over for dinner sometime. …Don't take that seriously!

t.zh: 那天在海边喊的那句，你就当没听见。……听见了也不许说。
t.en: What I shouted at the sea that day—pretend you didn't hear. …And if you did, don't you dare say so.

t.zh: 那天你上台的时候，腿一直在抖。我站在旁边，看得清清楚楚。
t.en: That night you came up on stage, your legs were shaking the whole time. I was right next to you. I saw everything.

t.zh: “五个人也是观众”——那句明明是我的台词，被你抢走了。
t.en: 'Five people is still an audience'—that was my line, and you stole it.

t.zh: 这周六的照片，别忘了。
t.en: Don't forget this Saturday's photo.

t.zh: 广播响了。列车进站。
t.en: The announcement sounds. The train pulls in.

t.zh: 七年前，我从这个站台离开，什么都没来得及说。
t.en: Seven years ago I left from this platform without getting a single word out.

text.zh: 最后一场。铁椅子坐满了，后来的人站到了海堤上。
text.en: The last show. Every iron seat is taken; latecomers stand along the seawall.

label.en: "Because the next day, I was leaving."

text.zh: ……原来你知道。
text.en: …So you did know.

t.zh: ……原来你知道。
t.en: …So you did know.

t.zh: 你那天睡得那么香。我一边看电影，一边想：明天开始，这个人就不在了。
t.en: You were sleeping so soundly. And I sat there watching the film, thinking: starting tomorrow, he won't be here.

label.en: "I don't know. Tell me."

text.zh: ……说出来，就不算了。
text.en: …If I say it, it won't count.

t.zh: ……说出来，就不算了。
t.en: …If I say it, it won't count.

t.zh: 不过今天的电影放完了，约也兑现了。那就说吧。
t.en: But today's film is nearly over, and the promise has been kept. So I'll say it.

t.zh: 因为我一直以为，你会回来。可是看着你睡着的样子，我突然知道，你不会了。
t.en: Because I'd always believed you'd come back. But watching you sleep, I suddenly knew you wouldn't.

label.en: "Because the film was sad, I guess."

text.zh: ……嗯。就当是吧。
text.en: …Mm. Let's say that.

t.zh: ……嗯。就当是吧。
t.en: …Mm. Let's say that.

t.zh: 她把头从我肩膀上抬起来，坐直了。
t.en: She lifts her head from my shoulder and sits up straight.

t.zh: 最后一场。铁椅子坐满了，后来的人站到了海堤上。
t.en: The last show. Every iron seat is taken; latecomers stand along the seawall.

t.zh: 第一排最左边的两个位置，椅背上用粉笔写着：“留座”。
t.en: On the two seats at the far left of the front row, someone has chalked on the backs: 'Reserved.'

t.zh: 沈澄看了你一眼，又低下头去忙手里的事，一句话也没说。
t.en: Shen Cheng glances at you, then goes back to what she's doing without a word.

t.zh: ……别看了。是我写的。
t.en: …Stop staring. I wrote it.

t.zh: 七年前，我们就坐在这两个位置。
t.en: Seven years ago, these were our seats.

t.zh: 电影开始了。放到一半，我的肩膀一沉——是她的头。她没睡着，眼睛睁着，看着银幕。
t.en: The film begins. Halfway through, my shoulder grows heavy—her head. She isn't asleep. Her eyes are open, on the screen.

t.zh: （小声）七年前那天，你在这里睡着了。我哭了。
t.en: (quietly) Seven years ago, you fell asleep right here. And I cried.

t.zh: 你知道我为什么哭吗？
t.en: Do you know why I cried?

text.zh: 散场后，我送她回咖啡馆。和七年前一样的路。
text.en: After the show I walk her back to the café. The same road as seven years ago.

label.en: "I haven't decided. …That's the truth."

text.zh: 嗯。你没摸耳朵。
text.en: Mm. You didn't touch your ear.

t.zh: 嗯。你没摸耳朵。
t.en: Mm. You didn't touch your ear.

t.zh: 那等你想好了，第一个告诉我。别让我从中介嘴里听到。
t.en: Then when you've decided, tell me first. Don't let me hear it from some agent.

label.en: "I'm not selling. I'm not leaving."

text.zh: ……不卖了？
text.en: …You're not selling?

t.zh: ……不卖了？
t.en: …You're not selling?

t.zh: 七年前，你也说过你会回来。
t.en: Seven years ago, you said you'd come back, too.

t.zh: 别随口答应我。我已经不是会相信这种话的小孩了。
t.en: Don't promise me things off the cuff. I'm not a kid who believes that kind of thing anymore.

label.zh: “卖了以后，我也会常回来看你。”
label.en: "Even if I sell, I'll come back to see you often."

text.zh: ……常回来。
text.en: …'Often.'

t.zh: ……常回来。
t.en: …'Often.'

t.zh: 晚安，陆远。
t.en: Good night, Lu Yuan.

t.zh: 风铃响了一下，门关上了。
t.en: The wind chime rings once, and the door closes.

t.zh: 散场后，我送她回咖啡馆。和七年前一样的路。
t.en: After the show I walk her back to the café. The same road as seven years ago.

t.zh: 沈澄看了你一眼，又低下头去忙手里的事，一句话也没说。
t.en: Shen Cheng glances at you, then goes back to what she's doing without a word.

t.zh: 约兑现了。陆远，我们两清了。
t.en: The promise is kept. Lu Yuan, we're even now.

t.zh: ……下午有个中介来店里，问你那栋老房子什么时候能看。
t.en: …A real estate agent came by the café this afternoon. Asked when they could view that old house of yours.

t.zh: 转学手续是临时办的：只在这里念一个学期。回来之前，我的打算是看完影院最后一场，把房子卖掉，回城里的学校去。
t.en: The transfer was only ever meant to be temporary: one semester here. Before I came back, the plan was to see the cinema's last show, sell the house, and go back to my university in the city.

t.zh: 要卖了，对吧。看完影院最后一场，你就又要走了。
t.en: You're selling, aren't you. Once you've seen the cinema's last show, you'll leave again.

text.zh: 影院开拆那周，沈澄的咖啡馆也要重新装修。打烊以后，我留下来帮她搬柜子。
text.en: The week the cinema comes down, Shen Cheng's café is being renovated too. After closing I stay to help her move the cabinets.

label.zh: 一封也不打开，把它们一个个捡起来放回罐子里，等她开口。
label.en: Open none of them. Pick them up one by one, put them back in the tin, and wait for her to speak.

text.zh: 我把盖子盖好，递给她。她接过去，抱在怀里，很久没说话。
text.en: I put the lid back on and hand it to her. She takes it and holds it against her chest, silent for a long time.

t.zh: 我把盖子盖好，递给她。她接过去，抱在怀里，很久没说话。
t.en: I put the lid back on and hand it to her. She takes it and holds it against her chest, silent for a long time.

t.zh: ……每年春天，影院开始放电影的那天，我写一封。
t.en: …Every spring, on the day the cinema started showing films again, I wrote one.

t.zh: 不知道寄到哪里。所以就放在这里。
t.en: I didn't know where to send them. So I kept them here.

t.zh: 今年的那一封……还没写。
t.en: This year's… I haven't written yet.

label.en: "Are these… for me?"

text.en: …Yes.

t.en: …Yes.

t.zh: 可是不给你看。一封都不给。
t.en: But you're not reading them. Not a single one.

t.zh: 里面有骂你的，有……别的。总之不给。
t.en: Some of them call you names. Some of them are… other things. Anyway, no.

label.zh: 捡起“第一个春天”那一封，拆开。
label.en: Pick up 'The first spring' and open it.

text.zh: 陆远！
text.en: Lu Yuan!

t.zh: 陆远！
t.en: Lu Yuan!

t.zh: 她一把夺了过去。信封的一角，被撕开了一道口子。
t.en: She snatches it out of my hand. One corner of the envelope is torn.

t.zh: ……你走吧。今天不用帮忙了。
t.en: …Go. You don't need to help tonight.

t.zh: 影院开拆那周，沈澄的咖啡馆也要重新装修。打烊以后，我留下来帮她搬柜子。
t.en: The week the cinema comes down, Shen Cheng's café is being renovated too. After closing I stay to help her move the cabinets.

t.zh: 沈澄看了你一眼，又低下头去忙手里的事，一句话也没说。
t.en: Shen Cheng glances at you, then goes back to what she's doing without a word.

t.zh: 那天晚上以后，她给我端咖啡，只说一句“请慢用”。和对任何一个客人都一样。
t.en: Since that night, when she brings me coffee she says only 'Enjoy.' The same as with any other customer.

t.zh: 最上面一格，掉下来一个旧可可罐，盖子摔开了。里面是一叠信封。
t.en: From the top shelf an old cocoa tin falls, and the lid pops off. Inside is a stack of envelopes.

t.zh: 七个。每一个上面写着一行字：“第一个春天”“第二个春天”……一直到“第七个春天”。最后一个，是空的，没有封口。
t.en: Seven of them. Each one bears a single line: 'The first spring,' 'The second spring'… all the way to 'The seventh spring.' The last one is empty, and unsealed.

t.zh: 收信人那一栏，写的都是我的名字。没有地址。
t.en: In the space for the addressee, every one has my name. No address.

t.zh: ……别看。
t.en: …Don't look.

text.zh: 海堤上，那只最小的猫一直跟着沈澄走。
text.en: On the seawall, the smallest of the cats keeps following Shen Cheng.

label.en: "Let it stay with me. The old house has a yard."

text.zh: ……你那里？
text.en: …With you?

t.zh: ……你那里？
t.en: …With you?

t.zh: 养猫要很久的。十几年。你想好了？
t.en: A cat is a long time. Over ten years. Have you thought this through?

t.zh: ……那我每天去喂。你不在的时候也去。
t.en: …Then I'll come feed it every day. Even when you're not around.

label.zh: “先给它起个名字。叫‘七’怎么样？”
label.en: "Let's name it first. How about 'Seven'?"

text.en: …Seven.

t.en: …Seven.

t.zh: 好听。可是名字起了，就得负责了。
t.en: It's a nice name. But once you've named it, you're responsible for it.

t.zh: 海堤上，那只最小的猫一直跟着沈澄走。
t.en: On the seawall, the smallest of the cats keeps following Shen Cheng.

t.zh: 沈澄看了你一眼，又低下头去忙手里的事，一句话也没说。
t.en: Shen Cheng glances at you, then goes back to what she's doing without a word.

t.zh: 装修的时候，店里不能养。可是不管它，它活不过这个夏天。
t.en: I can't keep it at the café during the renovation. But if no one takes it, it won't make it through the summer.

title.en: The Attic of the Old House

text.zh: 中介要来看房，我只好收拾老房子。沈澄提着水桶来了，说是“顺路”。
text.en: The agent is coming to view the place, so I have to clean up the old house. Shen Cheng turns up with a bucket, says she was 'passing by.'

label.en: "Seven years late. I'm giving it back."

text.zh: ……不要。
text.en: …I don't want it.

t.zh: ……不要。
t.en: …I don't want it.

t.zh: 还给我了，就真的两清了。你留着。
t.en: If you give it back, we really will be even. You keep it.

label.zh: 把伞放回箱子里：“这个，不卖。”
label.en: Put the umbrella back in the box: "This isn't for sale."

text.zh: 那房子呢？
text.en: And the house?

t.zh: 那房子呢？
t.en: And the house?

t.zh: 我没有回答。她也没有再问。
t.en: I don't answer. She doesn't ask again.

t.zh: 中介要来看房，我只好收拾老房子。沈澄提着水桶来了，说是“顺路”。
t.en: The agent is coming to view the place, so I have to clean up the old house. Shen Cheng turns up with a bucket, says she was 'passing by.'

t.zh: 沈澄看了你一眼，又低下头去忙手里的事，一句话也没说。
t.en: Shen Cheng glances at you, then goes back to what she's doing without a word.

t.zh: 阁楼的箱子里，有一把小小的黄色雨伞。伞柄上贴着一张褪色的贴纸：一只三花猫。
t.en: In a box in the attic there's a small yellow umbrella. On the handle, a faded sticker: a calico cat.

t.zh: ……这是我的。你走的那天下雨，我把伞给你了。
t.en: …That's mine. It rained the day you left, so I gave you my umbrella.

text.zh: 装修前的最后一天营业。沈澄说，要教我做那杯热可可。
text.en: The café's last day of business before the renovation. Shen Cheng says she'll teach me how to make that hot cocoa.

label.zh: 做好以后，放两块棉花糖，推到她面前。
label.en: When it's done, put in two marshmallows and slide it across to her.

text.zh: ……给我的？
text.en: …For me?

t.zh: ……给我的？
t.en: …For me?

t.zh: 我从来没喝过自己做的。……甜死了。
t.en: I've never had one I made myself. …It's sickeningly sweet.

t.zh: 她一口一口，全喝完了。
t.en: She drinks every last sip.

label.en: "After the renovation, put it on the menu."

text.zh: 写什么名字？
text.en: What would we call it?

t.zh: 写什么名字？
t.en: What would we call it?

t.zh: 就叫“第一排”。
t.en: Call it 'The Front Row.'

t.zh: ……俗。不过，可以。
t.en: …Corny. But fine.

t.zh: 装修前的最后一天营业。沈澄说，要教我做那杯热可可。
t.en: The café's last day of business before the renovation. Shen Cheng says she'll teach me how to make that hot cocoa.

t.zh: 沈澄看了你一眼，又低下头去忙手里的事，一句话也没说。
t.en: Shen Cheng glances at you, then goes back to what she's doing without a word.

t.zh: 可可粉两勺，牛奶别煮开。棉花糖最后放。
t.en: Two spoons of cocoa, and don't let the milk boil. The marshmallow goes in last.

t.zh: 你回来那天点的时候，我手都在抖。七年没人点过了。
t.en: The day you came back and ordered it, my hands were shaking. No one had ordered it in seven years.

text.zh: 周五下午，中介带着买家来了。合同摊在院子里的石桌上，枇杷树的影子落在纸上。
text.en: Friday afternoon, the agent brings the buyer. The contract is laid out on the stone table in the yard, the loquat tree's shadow falling across the page.

label.zh: 把笔还给中介：“对不起。不卖了。”
label.en: Hand the pen back to the agent: "I'm sorry. I'm not selling."

text.zh: 买家骂了几句，走了。中介摇着头，把合同收回了包里。
text.en: The buyer grumbles a few words and leaves. The agent shakes his head and puts the contract back in his bag.

t.zh: 买家骂了几句，走了。中介摇着头，把合同收回了包里。
t.en: The buyer grumbles a few words and leaves. The agent shakes his head and puts the contract back in his bag.

t.zh: 我给城里的学校发了一封邮件：下学期，我不回去了。发完以后，手机在手里攥了很久。
t.en: I email my university in the city: I won't be coming back next semester. Afterward, I hold the phone in my hand for a long time.

t.zh: 然后，我拨了她的号码。答应过的：第一个告诉她。
t.en: Then I dial her number. I promised: she'd be the first to know.

label.en: "Give me another week."

text.zh: 中介答应了，脸色不太好看。买家说，一周以后不签，他就买别家的。
text.en: The agent agrees, though he doesn't look pleased. The buyer says if it isn't signed in a week, he'll buy elsewhere.

t.zh: 中介答应了，脸色不太好看。买家说，一周以后不签，他就买别家的。
t.en: The agent agrees, though he doesn't look pleased. The buyer says if it isn't signed in a week, he'll buy elsewhere.

label.en: Sign.

text.zh: 我签了名字。笔尖划过纸的声音，比想象中响。
text.en: I sign my name. The scratch of the nib across the paper is louder than I expected.

t.zh: 我签了名字。笔尖划过纸的声音，比想象中响。
t.en: I sign my name. The scratch of the nib across the paper is louder than I expected.

t.zh: 周五下午，中介带着买家来了。合同摊在院子里的石桌上，枇杷树的影子落在纸上。
t.en: Friday afternoon, the agent brings the buyer. The contract is laid out on the stone table in the yard, the loquat tree's shadow falling across the page.

t.zh: “签了字，下个月就能过户。”中介把笔递给我。
t.en: 'Sign here, and the transfer goes through next month.' The agent holds out a pen.

t.zh: 院子角落里，那只叫“七”的小猫正在睡觉。
t.en: In a corner of the yard, the little cat called Seven is asleep.

t.zh: 阁楼的箱子里，还有一把黄色的伞。
t.en: Up in the attic, in a box, there's still a yellow umbrella.

t.zh: 那天晚上，我随口说过“不卖了”。她说她不信。
t.en: That night I said 'I'm not selling' without thinking. She said she didn't believe me.

t.zh: 她说过：想好了，第一个告诉她。
t.en: She said: when you've decided, tell me first.

t.zh: 沈澄没有来。她说今天要盯着店里装修。
t.en: Shen Cheng didn't come. She said she had to keep an eye on the café renovation today.

text.zh: 夜里，沈澄在海堤上等我。手里拿着那个可可罐。
text.en: That night, Shen Cheng waits for me on the seawall, the cocoa tin in her hands.

label.zh: “那第七封，我们一起写。写好了，寄到老房子去。”
label.en: "Then we'll write the seventh one together. And mail it to the old house."

text.zh: ……寄到老房子？
text.en: …To the old house?

t.zh: ……寄到老房子？
t.en: …To the old house?

t.zh: 寄信要走七百米，送信的会骂人的。
t.en: That's seven hundred meters for the mailman. He'll curse us.

t.zh: 她打开罐子，把空的那个信封拿出来，和笔一起放在我手里。
t.en: She opens the tin, takes out the empty envelope, and puts it in my hand together with a pen.

t.zh: 第一句，你写。我等了七年，就等这一句。
t.en: You write the first line. I've waited seven years for that line.

t.zh: “我回来了。这次，不走了。”
t.en: 'I'm back. This time, I'm staying.'
…Mm.

t.zh: 欢迎回来，阿远。
t.en: Welcome back, Yuan.

t.zh: 那是七年来，她第一次叫我的小名。
t.en: It's the first time in seven years she's called me by my childhood name.

label.en: Take the cocoa tin.

text.zh: 都给你。……从今往后，我不写了。
text.en: They're all yours. …From now on, I won't write any more.

t.zh: 都给你。……从今往后，我不写了。
t.en: They're all yours. …From now on, I won't write any more.

t.zh: 一路顺风，陆远。
t.en: Safe travels, Lu Yuan.

t.zh: 她转身走了。海风很大，罐子在我手里很轻。
t.en: She turns and walks away. The sea wind is strong, and the tin is very light in my hands.

t.zh: 夜里，沈澄在海堤上等我。手里拿着那个可可罐。
t.en: That night, Shen Cheng waits for me on the seawall, the cocoa tin in her hands.

t.zh: 沈澄看了你一眼，又低下头去忙手里的事，一句话也没说。
t.en: Shen Cheng glances at you, then goes back to what she's doing without a word.

t.zh: 中介来店里了，说你把买家气走了。……笨蛋。
t.en: The agent came by the café. Said you drove the buyer off. …Idiot.

t.zh: 那天你说你想起来了。……其实，我一直在等你说这句话。
t.en: That day you said you remembered. …Honestly, I'd been waiting for you to say that.

t.zh: 听说签了。……挺好的。城里的学校，总要回去的。
t.en: I heard you signed. …That's good. You have to go back to your university in the city eventually.

t.zh: 听说你让人家再等一周。……你总是让人等。
t.en: I heard you asked them to wait another week. …You're always making people wait.

t.zh: 这七封信，我想了很久要怎么办。
t.en: I've thought for a long time about what to do with these seven letters.

t.zh: 那天你一封都没拆。……谢谢。
t.en: That day you didn't open a single one. …Thank you.

t.zh: 被你撕开的那一封，我用胶带粘好了。
t.en: The one you tore open—I taped it back together.

t.zh: 第一排那晚，你问我为什么哭。我只说了一半。另一半，都在这里面。
t.en: That night in the front row, you asked why I cried. I only told you half. The other half is all in here.

t.zh: 第七个信封是空的。今年，我写不出来了。
t.en: The seventh envelope is empty. This year, I couldn't write it.

text.zh: 零点过后。放映室里只开了一盏灯。季白把第七卷装上放映机，手停在开关上。
text.en: Past midnight. A single lamp is lit in the booth. Ji Bai threads reel seven onto the projector, and her hand stops on the switch.

label.zh: “剪掉的那一段，我们把它找回来。”
label.en: "Whatever he cut out—we'll find it."

text.en: …Find it?

t.en: …Find it?

t.zh: 胶片是会坏的。剪下来放了七年，可能已经粘成一团了。
t.en: Film decays. If it's been sitting cut loose for seven years, it may have fused into a lump.

t.zh: 不过，修胶片的人，最喜欢的就是这种事。
t.en: But for someone who restores film, that's exactly the kind of job we love.

label.zh: “那张床……我小时候真的在这里睡过很多次。”
label.en: "That cot… I really did sleep here, lots of times, as a kid."

text.zh: 他拍了你很多次。每一次，镜头都很稳。
text.en: He filmed you over and over. Every time, the camera was steady.

t.zh: 他拍了你很多次。每一次，镜头都很稳。
t.en: He filmed you over and over. Every time, the camera was steady.

t.zh: 陆同学，他很想你。胶片不会说谎。
t.en: Mr. Lu, he missed you. Film doesn't lie.

label.zh: “他剪掉，就是不想让人看。算了吧。”
label.en: "If he cut it, he didn't want it seen. Let it go."

text.en: …Mm.

t.en: …Mm.

t.zh: 她把胶片倒回去，放进铁盒，在盖子上贴了一张新标签：“第七卷（不完整）”。
t.en: She rewinds the film, puts it back in its tin, and sticks a new label on the lid: 'Reel 7 (incomplete).'

t.zh: 零点过后。放映室里只开了一盏灯。季白把第七卷装上放映机，手停在开关上。
t.en: Past midnight. A single lamp is lit in the booth. Ji Bai threads reel seven onto the projector, and her hand stops on the switch.

t.zh: 季白对你点了点头，客气得像对一个陌生人。
t.en: Ji Bai nods to you, as politely as she would to a stranger.

t.zh: 我修好了，可是一格都没看。……你来开。
t.en: I've restored it, but I haven't watched a single frame. …You turn it on.

t.zh: 第一格，是一片海。然后是潮声影院，刚刷过漆的银幕。再然后，是放映室里那张小床——床上睡着一个小孩。
t.en: The first frame is the sea. Then the Tidesound, its screen freshly painted. Then the little cot in the booth—and a child asleep on it.

t.zh: 是我。
t.en: It's me.

t.zh: 画面里有很多个春天：银幕补了又补，椅子换了一排又一排，第一排有个小女孩在哭。最后，是空荡荡的座位，和一行手写的字幕：“第七个春天”。
t.en: There are many springs on the film: the screen patched again and again, the seats replaced row by row, a little girl crying in the front row. And at the end, empty seats, and one handwritten title card: 'The Seventh Spring.'

t.zh: 然后，画面断了。只剩一道歪歪扭扭的接缝。
t.en: Then the picture cuts off. All that's left is a crooked splice.

t.zh: ……后面被剪掉了。剪得很急。他的手在抖。
t.en: …The rest has been cut. In a hurry. His hands were shaking.

text.zh: 晚上，最后一场。三百多人坐在下面，我和季白在放映室里。从小窗望出去，银幕亮得像一扇门。
text.en: Evening, the last show. Over three hundred people below; Ji Bai and I up in the booth. Through the little window, the screen glows like a doorway.

label.en: "Tonight, we'll watch it to the end. Together."

text.zh: ……一起？
text.en: …Together?

t.zh: ……一起？
t.en: …Together?

t.zh: 她慢慢转过身来。我们挤在那扇小窗前面，肩膀挨着肩膀。
t.en: Slowly, she turns around. We squeeze in front of the little window, shoulder to shoulder.

t.zh: 片尾字幕升起来的时候，下面的三百个人一起鼓掌。季白没有鼓掌。她在哭，哭得很安静。
t.en: As the end credits rise, the three hundred people below applaud together. Ji Bai doesn't clap. She's crying, very quietly.

t.zh: ……原来结束是这个样子的。也不是很可怕。
t.en: …So this is what an ending looks like. It isn't all that frightening.

label.en: "Then I'll watch it for you. I'll tell you what happens."

text.zh: 我站在小窗前，一句一句地讲。她背对着银幕，闭着眼睛听。
text.en: I stand at the window and describe it line by line. She sits with her back to the screen, eyes closed, listening.

t.zh: 我站在小窗前，一句一句地讲。她背对着银幕，闭着眼睛听。
t.en: I stand at the window and describe it line by line. She sits with her back to the screen, eyes closed, listening.

t.zh: ……你讲得比电影好。
t.en: …You tell it better than the film does.

label.zh: 什么也不说，陪她背对着坐下。
label.en: Say nothing. Sit down beside her, back to the window.

text.zh: 我们背对着银幕坐了一卷的时间。放映机嗒嗒地响，像一只很大的钟。
text.en: We sit with our backs to the screen for the length of a reel. The projector clatters away like a very large clock.

t.zh: 我们背对着银幕坐了一卷的时间。放映机嗒嗒地响，像一只很大的钟。
t.en: We sit with our backs to the screen for the length of a reel. The projector clatters away like a very large clock.

t.zh: 晚上，最后一场。三百多人坐在下面，我和季白在放映室里。从小窗望出去，银幕亮得像一扇门。
t.en: Evening, the last show. Over three hundred people below; Ji Bai and I up in the booth. Through the little window, the screen glows like a doorway.

t.zh: 季白对你点了点头，客气得像对一个陌生人。
t.en: Ji Bai nods to you, as politely as she would to a stranger.

t.zh: 还有一卷就放完了。
t.en: One more reel and it's over.

t.zh: 你问过我，为什么害怕结束。今天，我想试试看完它。
t.en: You asked me once why endings frighten me. Today, I want to try watching to the end.

t.zh: 她把最后一卷装上机器，然后转过身，背对着小窗坐下了。
t.en: She threads the final reel onto the machine, then turns around and sits down with her back to the window.

t.zh: 我从来不看最后一卷。每一部都是。只看焦点，不看故事。
t.en: I never watch the final reel. Not of any film. I check the focus, I don't watch the story.

t.zh: 看了，就结束了。
t.en: If I watch it, it's over.

text.zh: 周一，拆迁队进场。收废品的三轮车停在放映室楼下。
text.en: Monday, the demolition crew moves in. A scrap collector's tricycle is parked below the booth.

label.en: "Eight hundred? I'll buy the small one."

text.zh: ……你买放映机做什么？你又不会放。
text.en: …What do you want with a projector? You don't know how to run one.

t.zh: 义卖海报剩下的钱，正好够。
t.en: What's left from the poster sale covers it exactly.

t.zh: 我把钱包里的钱全掏了出来，还差两百。老周骂了一句，替我补上了。
t.en: I empty my wallet and come up two hundred short. Old Zhou swears once and makes up the difference.

t.zh: ……你买放映机做什么？你又不会放。
t.en: …What do you want with a projector? You don't know how to run one.

t.zh: 你会。
t.en: You do.

t.zh: ……这是我听过最不讲道理的话。
t.en: …That's the most unreasonable thing I've ever heard.

label.zh: “资料馆是好地方。第七卷在那里，不会再坏了。”
label.en: "The archive's a good place. Reel seven would never decay there."

text.zh: ……嗯。你说得对。
text.en: …Mm. You're right.

t.zh: ……嗯。你说得对。
t.en: …Mm. You're right.

t.zh: 修胶片的人，本来就应该去那种地方。
t.en: People who restore film belong in places like that.

label.en: "Do you want to go?"

text.zh: ……没有人问过我这个。
text.en: …No one's ever asked me that.

t.zh: ……没有人问过我这个。
t.en: …No one's ever asked me that.

t.zh: 我不知道。我只知道，影院拆了以后，我每天晚上都会醒，以为放映机还在转。
t.en: I don't know. I only know that since they started tearing the cinema down, I wake up every night thinking the projector's still running.

t.zh: 周一，拆迁队进场。收废品的三轮车停在放映室楼下。
t.en: Monday, the demolition crew moves in. A scrap collector's tricycle is parked below the booth.

t.zh: 放映机……按斤称。两台，八百。
t.en: The projectors… go by weight. The pair of them, eight hundred.

t.zh: 季白对你点了点头，客气得像对一个陌生人。
t.en: Ji Bai nods to you, as politely as she would to a stranger.

t.zh: 陆同学，有件事我还没说。
t.en: Mr. Lu, there's something I haven't told you.

t.zh: 北京的电影资料馆要我去修片子。七月报到。……他们说，第七卷也可以一起带去，好好保存。
t.en: The National Film Archive in Beijing wants me to restore films for them. I start in July. …They say reel seven can come too, to be properly preserved.

t.zh: 影院没了，放映机也没了。我在汐川，已经没有可以放电影的地方了。
t.en: The cinema's gone. The projectors will be gone. There's nowhere left in Xichuan for me to run a film.

title.en: A Newspaper from Fourteen Years Ago

text.zh: 图书馆三楼，季白翻出了一摞旧报纸。
text.en: On the library's third floor, Ji Bai has dug out a stack of old newspapers.

label.zh: “只放一次……那一次，他想放给谁看？”
label.en: "Only once… Who did he want to show it to?"

text.zh: ……陆同学。
text.en: …Mr. Lu.

t.zh: ……陆同学。
t.en: …Mr. Lu.

t.zh: 你在问一个答案很明显的问题。
t.en: You're asking a question with a very obvious answer.

label.zh: 把那篇报道复印下来，夹进第七卷的铁盒里。
label.en: Photocopy the article and tuck it into reel seven's tin.

text.zh: 好主意。片子和说明书，放在一起。
text.en: Good idea. The film and its notes, kept together.

t.zh: 好主意。片子和说明书，放在一起。
t.en: Good idea. The film and its notes, kept together.

t.zh: 图书馆三楼，季白翻出了一摞旧报纸。
t.en: On the library's third floor, Ji Bai has dug out a stack of old newspapers.

t.zh: 季白对你点了点头，客气得像对一个陌生人。
t.en: Ji Bai nods to you, as politely as she would to a stranger.

t.zh: 找到了。十四年前的汐川晚报。“潮声影院的放映员老陆，在拍一部关于小城的电影。”
t.en: Found it. The Xichuan Evening News, fourteen years ago. 'Old Lu, projectionist at the Tidesound, is making a film about our little town.'

t.zh: 片名叫《第七个春天》。他说，要拍七个春天，拍完了，只放一次。
t.en: It's called The Seventh Spring. He said he'd shoot it over seven springs, and when it was done, it would be shown only once.

text.zh: 放映室明天就要拆了。季白在打包最后一箱胶片，我坐在那张小床上。床太小了，腿伸不直。
text.en: The booth comes down tomorrow. Ji Bai is packing the last box of film; I'm sitting on the little cot. It's too small now. My legs won't stretch out.

label.zh: “那今天，你再睡最后一次。我替你守着。”
label.en: "Then sleep there one last time today. I'll keep watch."

text.zh: 她蜷在小床上，很快就睡着了。我坐在放映机旁边，听了一下午的海。
text.en: She curls up on the cot and falls asleep almost at once. I sit by the projector and listen to the sea all afternoon.

t.zh: 她蜷在小床上，很快就睡着了。我坐在放映机旁边，听了一下午的海。
t.en: She curls up on the cot and falls asleep almost at once. I sit by the projector and listen to the sea all afternoon.

t.zh: （醒来）……你一直在？
t.en: (waking) …You stayed the whole time?

label.zh: 在床板背面刻下两个人的名字。
label.en: Carve both your names into the underside of the cot.

text.zh: ……你在破坏文物。
text.en: …You're vandalizing a historical artifact.

t.zh: ……你在破坏文物。
t.en: …You're vandalizing a historical artifact.

t.zh: 她嘴上这么说，还是接过小刀，在我的名字旁边，一笔一画地刻上了“季白”。
t.en: She says that, but she takes the knife anyway and, stroke by careful stroke, carves 'Ji Bai' beside my name.

t.zh: 放映室明天就要拆了。季白在打包最后一箱胶片，我坐在那张小床上。床太小了，腿伸不直。
t.en: The booth comes down tomorrow. Ji Bai is packing the last box of film; I'm sitting on the little cot. It's too small now. My legs won't stretch out.

t.zh: 季白对你点了点头，客气得像对一个陌生人。
t.en: Ji Bai nods to you, as politely as she would to a stranger.

t.zh: 这两年，我修片修到太晚，就在这张床上睡。
t.en: These two years, whenever I worked too late, I slept on that cot.

t.zh: ……原来，我一直睡在你的床上。
t.en: …So all this time, I've been sleeping in your bed.

text.zh: 仓库要清空了。我们把第七个架子搬开，后面的墙上，用图钉钉着一张便签。
text.en: The storeroom is being cleared. We move the seventh shelf aside; on the wall behind it, a note is pinned up with a thumbtack.

label.en: "We'll look tonight."

text.zh: 好。我带手套。胶片不能用手直接碰。
text.en: All right. I'll bring gloves. You can't touch film with bare hands.

t.zh: 好。我带手套。胶片不能用手直接碰。
t.en: All right. I'll bring gloves. You can't touch film with bare hands.

label.zh: 把便签小心取下来，夹进第七卷的铁盒里。
label.en: Take the note down carefully and tuck it into reel seven's tin.

text.zh: ……你开始像个修胶片的人了。
text.en: …You're starting to act like a film restorer.

t.zh: ……你开始像个修胶片的人了。
t.en: …You're starting to act like a film restorer.

t.zh: 仓库要清空了。我们把第七个架子搬开，后面的墙上，用图钉钉着一张便签。
t.en: The storeroom is being cleared. We move the seventh shelf aside; on the wall behind it, a note is pinned up with a thumbtack.

t.zh: 季白对你点了点头，客气得像对一个陌生人。
t.en: Ji Bai nods to you, as politely as she would to a stranger.

t.zh: 是爷爷的字：“剩下的，在家里。”
t.en: It's my grandfather's handwriting: 'The rest is at home.'

t.zh: ……家里。陆同学，是你家。
t.en: …At home. Mr. Lu, that means your house.

text.zh: 盒盖上贴着一张纸：“给远”。
text.en: There's a slip of paper taped to the lid: 'For Yuan.'

label.zh: “把它接回去。明天晚上，我们把第七卷完整地放一遍。”
label.en: "Splice it back in. Tomorrow night, we'll run reel seven all the way through."

text.zh: 放在哪里？影院已经没有了。
text.en: Where? There's no cinema anymore.

t.zh: 放在哪里？影院已经没有了。
t.en: Where? There's no cinema anymore.

t.zh: 放映机在我这里。银幕的话——海堤上，挂一块白布就够了。
t.en: I've got the projector. As for a screen—on the seawall, a white sheet will do.

t.zh: 我去借。学校的、文化馆的，总有一台还能转。
t.en: I'll borrow one. The university's, the community center's—one of them must still run.

t.zh: ……好。今晚我不睡了。一格都不会接错。
t.en: …All right. I won't sleep tonight. Not a single frame will be out of place.

label.en: "It's for me. …I'd like to watch it alone first."

text.zh: ……嗯。应该的。
text.en: …Mm. Of course.

t.zh: ……嗯。应该的。
t.en: …Mm. Of course.

t.zh: 她把铁盒递给我，脱下白手套，放在铁盒上面，自己下楼去了。
t.en: She hands me the tin, takes off her white gloves, lays them on top of it, and goes downstairs alone.

t.zh: “剩下的，在家里。”我们从晚上找到半夜，最后在阁楼的樟木箱底下，找到了一个很小的铁盒。
t.en: 'The rest is at home.' We search from evening until midnight, and at last, at the bottom of a camphor chest in the attic, we find a very small tin.

t.zh: 收拾阁楼的时候，樟木箱底下掉出来一个很小的铁盒。
t.en: While clearing out the attic, a very small tin drops from the bottom of a camphor chest.

t.zh: 盒盖上贴着一张纸：“给远”。
t.en: There's a slip of paper taped to the lid: 'For Yuan.'

t.zh: 季白对你点了点头，客气得像对一个陌生人。
t.en: Ji Bai nods to you, as politely as she would to a stranger.

t.zh: ……就是它。第七卷剪掉的那一段。
t.en: …This is it. The part cut from reel seven.

t.zh: 你说过要找回来。……你真的找到了。
t.en: You said we'd find it. …And you actually did.

t.zh: 胶片还好。他存得很仔细。
t.en: The film's in good shape. He stored it very carefully.

text.zh: 海堤上挂起了一块白布。来的人不多：老周，程航，几个路过的学生，还有一只猫。
text.en: A white sheet hangs on the seawall. Not many come: Old Zhou, Cheng Hang, a few passing students, and a cat.

label.zh: “留在汐川。我们开一家没有影院的电影院。每个周六，海堤上，放一场。”
label.en: "Stay in Xichuan. We'll open a cinema without a cinema. Every Saturday, on the seawall, one show."

text.zh: ……这是我听过最不合理的提议。没有座位，没有屋顶，下雨就要停。
text.en: …That's the least reasonable proposal I've ever heard. No seats, no roof, and every rain cancels the show.

t.zh: ……这是我听过最不合理的提议。没有座位，没有屋顶，下雨就要停。
t.en: …That's the least reasonable proposal I've ever heard. No seats, no roof, and every rain cancels the show.

t.zh: 可是，你说的时候，没有一点要结束的样子。
t.en: But when you say it, there's nothing about it that sounds like an ending.

t.zh: ……陆远。我留下来。放映员，和你。
t.en: …Lu Yuan. I'll stay. As the projectionist—and with you.

t.zh: 那是她第一次，叫我的名字。
t.en: It's the first time she's called me by my name.

label.zh: “去资料馆吧。那里，什么都不会结束。”
label.en: "Go to the archive. Nothing ever has to end there."

text.en: …Mm.

t.en: …Mm.

t.zh: 谢谢你，陆同学。第七卷，我会照顾好它。
t.en: Thank you, Mr. Lu. I'll take good care of reel seven.

t.zh: 海堤上挂起了一块白布。来的人不多：老周，程航，几个路过的学生，还有一只猫。
t.en: A white sheet hangs on the seawall. Not many come: Old Zhou, Cheng Hang, a few passing students, and a cat.

t.zh: 季白对你点了点头，客气得像对一个陌生人。
t.en: Ji Bai nods to you, as politely as she would to a stranger.

t.zh: 那一段，我一个人看完以后，还是交给了她。她接得很整齐，看不出接缝。
t.en: After I watched that section alone, I gave it to her in the end. She spliced it so neatly you can't see the join.

t.zh: 报纸上说，这部片子只放一次。今晚，就是那一次。
t.en: The newspaper said this film would be shown only once. Tonight is that once.

t.zh: 放映机转起来了。第一格，是一片海。
t.en: The projector starts to turn. The first frame is the sea.

t.zh: 所有的春天放完以后，接缝过去，画面上出现了一个人。是爷爷。他坐在放映室的小床旁边，对着镜头，有点不好意思。
t.en: After all the springs have played, the splice goes by, and a man appears on screen. It's my grandfather. He's sitting beside the cot in the booth, facing the camera, a little embarrassed.

t.zh: “远。你要是看到这个，说明你回来了。那年你爸带你走，我没有留你。对不起。”
t.en: 'Yuan. If you're watching this, it means you came back. The year your dad took you away, I didn't ask you to stay. I'm sorry.'

t.zh: “这部片子，我只想放一次。最后一场，留给你放。”
t.en: 'I only ever wanted this film shown once. The last show is yours to run.'

t.zh: 画面暗了。海堤上，没有人说话。
t.en: The picture fades. On the seawall, no one speaks.

t.zh: 季白一直看到了最后一格。这一次，她没有转过身去。
t.en: Ji Bai watched all the way to the last frame. This time, she didn't turn away.

t.zh: ……陆同学。他说，最后一场，留给你放。
t.en: …Mr. Lu. He said the last show is yours to run.

t.zh: 那我呢？七月以后，我去哪里放？
t.en: And what about me? After July, where do I run films?

text.zh: 转学到汐川大学的第一天，室友程航就把我拖到了社团招新的广场上。
text.en: On my first day at Xichuan University, my roommate Cheng Hang drags me to the club fair in the square.

label.en: Go after Shen Cheng.

text.zh: 有事？
text.en: Something you need?

t.zh: 有事？
t.en: Something you need?

t.zh: ……好久不见。
t.en: …It's been a long time.

t.zh: 七年。不是“好久”。
t.en: Seven years. Not 'a long time.'

t.zh: 她走到拐角时，回头看了一眼。
t.en: At the corner, she glances back once.

label.en: Ask Ji Bai where the booth is.

text.zh: 银幕对面的小楼上。你祖父的东西，都还在那里。
text.en: In the little building facing the screen. Your grandfather's things are all still there.

t.zh: 银幕对面的小楼上。你祖父的东西，都还在那里。
t.en: In the little building facing the screen. Your grandfather's things are all still there.

label.en: Walk away alone.

text.zh: 广场上很吵。我在人群里走了很久，才走到海边。
text.en: The square is loud. I walk a long way through the crowd before I reach the sea.

t.zh: 广场上很吵。我在人群里走了很久，才走到海边。
