t.en: The square is loud. I walk a long way through the crowd before I reach the sea.

t.zh: 转学到汐川大学的第一天，室友程航就把我拖到了社团招新的广场上。
t.en: On my first day at Xichuan University, my roommate Cheng Hang drags me to the club fair in the square.

t.zh: 听我的，大三转学生想融入，只有一条路：社团。
t.en: Trust me. A third-year transfer has one way to fit in: clubs.

t.zh: 最角落的摊位上，摆着一台老式放映机。摊位后面坐着的，是昨天那个女孩。
t.en: At the farthest corner booth sits an old projector. Behind it is the girl from yesterday.

t.zh: 她看见了我，把报名表往桌上一扣，转过身去跟别人说话。
t.en: She sees me, slaps the sign-up sheet face down on the table, and turns to talk to someone else.

t.zh: 昨天那句话，收不回来了。
t.en: What I said yesterday can't be taken back.

t.zh: 季白对你点了点头，客气得像对一个陌生人。
t.en: Ji Bai nods to you, as politely as she would to a stranger.

t.zh: ……你就是陆同学？社长让我转告你：电影社不缺人。
t.en: …You're Mr. Lu? The president asked me to tell you: the film club isn't short of members.

t.zh: 不过，放映室的门白天一般开着。那是影院的，不是社团的。
t.en: Though the booth door is usually open during the day. It belongs to the cinema, not the club.

t.zh: 沈澄看了你一眼，又低下头去忙手里的事，一句话也没说。
t.en: Shen Cheng glances at you, then goes back to what she's doing without a word.

t.zh: ……陆远。回来了啊。
t.en: …Lu Yuan. So you're back.

t.zh: 我还要送咖啡。
t.en: I've got coffee to deliver.

text.zh: 周六傍晚。我没有进影院，坐在海堤上，隔着铁栏杆看银幕。
text.en: Saturday evening. I don't go into the cinema. I sit on the seawall and watch the screen through the iron railing.

label.zh: 拿着钥匙去放映室，帮季白接片。
label.en: Take the key to the booth and help Ji Bai splice the film.

text.zh: 社长说过，不让你进来。
text.en: The president said you weren't to come in.

t.zh: 季白对你点了点头，客气得像对一个陌生人。
t.en: Ji Bai nods to you, as politely as she would to a stranger.

t.zh: 社长说过，不让你进来。
t.en: The president said you weren't to come in.

t.zh: ……算了。按住这里，别抖。
t.en: …Never mind. Hold it here. Don't shake.

t.zh: 三分钟后，银幕重新亮了起来。
t.en: Three minutes later, the screen lights up again.

label.zh: 看见沈澄提着空保温桶往外走，追上去送她回家。
label.en: See Shen Cheng leaving with the empty flask, and walk her home.

text.zh: 你在外面坐了一晚上？
text.en: You sat out here all evening?

t.zh: 沈澄看了你一眼，又低下头去忙手里的事，一句话也没说。
t.en: Shen Cheng glances at you, then goes back to what she's doing without a word.

t.zh: 你在外面坐了一晚上？
t.en: You sat out here all evening?

t.zh: ……你小时候，也总是一个人坐在栏杆外面。
t.en: …When we were kids, you'd always sit outside the railing on your own too.

label.en: Stay outside the railing and watch to the end.

text.zh: 银幕重新亮起来的时候，我听见台上那个女孩松了一口气。她没有往这边看。
text.en: When the screen comes back on, I hear the girl on the stage let out a breath. She doesn't look this way.

t.zh: 银幕重新亮起来的时候，我听见台上那个女孩松了一口气。她没有往这边看。
t.en: When the screen comes back on, I hear the girl on the stage let out a breath. She doesn't look this way.

t.zh: 周六傍晚。我没有进影院，坐在海堤上，隔着铁栏杆看银幕。
t.en: Saturday evening. I don't go into the cinema. I sit on the seawall and watch the screen through the iron railing.

t.zh: 老陆的孙子？进去坐啊。……哦，跟社长闹翻了？
t.en: Old Lu's grandson? Go on in and sit down. …Oh. Fell out with the president, did you?

t.zh: 放映室的钥匙，你爷爷说过，哪天你回来了就给你。喏。去不去，你自己定。
t.en: Your grandfather said if you ever came back, I was to give you the booth key. Here. Whether you use it is up to you.

t.zh: 七点，银幕亮了。来的人一共五个。放到一半，放映室那边传来一声闷响——画面停住，烧出一个白洞。
t.en: Seven o'clock, and the screen lights up. Five people in all. Halfway through, a dull snap comes from the booth—the picture freezes and a white hole burns through it.

text.zh: 四月初，学生处的通知贴了出来：电影社月底前凑不齐三个人，就撤销。
text.en: Early April, Student Affairs posts a notice: if the film club doesn't have three members by month's end, it's dissolved.

label.en: Go find Ji Bai in the booth.

text.zh: 社长来问过我。我入了。她一个人撑不下去。
text.en: The president asked me. I joined. She can't hold it together on her own.

t.zh: 季白对你点了点头，客气得像对一个陌生人。
t.en: Ji Bai nods to you, as politely as she would to a stranger.

t.zh: 社长来问过我。我入了。她一个人撑不下去。
t.en: The president asked me. I joined. She can't hold it together on her own.

t.zh: 你们之间的事，我不问。可放映室，你随时可以来。
t.en: Whatever's between you two, I won't ask. But you can come to the booth any time.

label.en: Go find Shen Cheng at the café.

text.zh: 她来问过我要不要入社。……我答应了。
text.en: She came and asked if I'd join. …I said yes.

t.zh: 沈澄看了你一眼，又低下头去忙手里的事，一句话也没说。
t.en: Shen Cheng glances at you, then goes back to what she's doing without a word.

t.zh: 她来问过我要不要入社。……我答应了。
t.en: She came and asked if I'd join. …I said yes.

t.zh: 潮声影院的最后一场，我本来就要去的。
t.en: I was going to be at the Tidesound's last show anyway.

hint.en: She won't give you the time of day yet

label.en: Do nothing.

text.zh: 月底，电影社凑够了三个人。那天我在宿舍里，听程航说的。
text.en: By month's end, the film club has its three members. I hear about it from Cheng Hang, back in the dorm.

t.zh: 月底，电影社凑够了三个人。那天我在宿舍里，听程航说的。
t.en: By month's end, the film club has its three members. I hear about it from Cheng Hang, back in the dorm.

t.zh: 四月初，学生处的通知贴了出来：电影社月底前凑不齐三个人，就撤销。
t.en: Early April, Student Affairs posts a notice: if the film club doesn't have three members by month's end, it's dissolved.

t.zh: 我看见夏知遥在公告栏前站了很久，然后一个摊位一个摊位地去问。没有人停下来。
t.en: I see Zhiyao stand in front of the board for a long time, then go from booth to booth asking. No one stops.

t.zh: 这件事，已经没有我的位置了。
t.en: There's no place for me in this anymore.

text.zh: ……你再说一遍？
text.en: …Say that again?

label.en: "…I'm sorry."

text.zh: 她没有回头。
text.en: She doesn't look back.

t.zh: 她没有回头。
t.en: She doesn't look back.

label.en: "…I'm sorry."

text.zh: 她没有回头。
text.en: She doesn't look back.

t.zh: 她没有回头。
t.en: She doesn't look back.

t.zh: 那是那个春天，我最后一次见到她。
t.en: That was the last time I saw her that spring.

label.en: Watch her walk away.

text.zh: 那天以后，我们在路上遇见，她都会绕开。
text.en: From that day on, whenever we pass each other, she takes the long way around.

t.en: That was the last time I saw her that spring.

t.zh: ……你再说一遍？
t.en: …Say that again?

t.zh: 她把手里的东西往桌上一放。声音不大，可周围的人都安静了。
t.en: She sets down whatever she's holding. Her voice isn't loud, but everyone around goes quiet.

t.zh: 我以为你跟别人不一样。是我看错了。
t.en: I thought you were different from the others. I was wrong.

t.zh: 电影社的事，以后你不用来了。
t.en: You don't need to come to the film club anymore.

text.zh: 沈澄的脸一下子白了。
text.en: The color drains from Shen Cheng's face.

text.en: She doesn't look back.

t.zh: 七年。我等来的就是这个。
t.en: Seven years. And this is what I waited for.

t.zh: 陆远，以后别来店里了。
t.en: Lu Yuan, don't come to the café anymore.

text.zh: 季白摘下眼镜，慢慢擦了擦，又戴上。
text.en: Ji Bai takes off her glasses, wipes them slowly, and puts them back on.

text.en: From that day on, whenever we pass each other, she takes the long way around.

t.zh: 那是那个春天，我最后一次见到她。
t.en: That was the last time I saw her that spring.

t.zh: 季白摘下眼镜，慢慢擦了擦，又戴上。
t.en: Ji Bai takes off her glasses, wipes them slowly, and puts them back on.

t.zh: 陆同学。有些话，说出来就剪不掉了。
t.en: Mr. Lu. Some things, once they're said, can't be cut out.

t.zh: 放映室的钥匙，请还给我。
t.en: Please give me back the key to the booth.

text.zh: 那个春天提前结束了。很久以后再想起来，最清楚的不是她的样子，是那天自己说出口的那句话。
text.en: That spring ended early. Long afterward, what I remember most clearly isn't her face—it's the words I said that day.

title.zh: 夏知遥 · 好结局「第八个春天」
title.en: Xia Zhiyao · Good Ending: The Eighth Spring

text.zh: 第二年三月，汐川的海堤上挂起了一块缝补过的白布，右下角的颜色和别处不一样。来了四十三个人。开场前五分钟，最早那班车进站了。一个扎着侧马尾的女孩拖着箱子一路跑过来，坐进了第一排正中间。“社长，你迟到了。”“……闭嘴。开始吧。”
text.en: The next March, a patched white canvas goes up on the Xichuan seawall; its bottom-right corner is a different shade from the rest. Forty-three people come. Five minutes before the show, the first train of the morning pulls in. A girl with a side ponytail comes running all the way from the station, dragging a suitcase, and drops into the front row, dead center. 'You're late, President.' '…Shut up. Let's begin.'

title.zh: 夏知遥 · 普通结局「春天过去了」
title.en: Xia Zhiyao · Normal Ending: And Spring Passed

text.zh: 一开始，她每周都会发来照片：老家的天空，医院窗外的树。后来，照片越来越少。第二年春天，我在海堤上放了一场电影，第一排的那个位置空着。散场的时候我才明白，有些话，在站台上不说，就再也说不出口了。
text.en: At first she sends photos every week: the sky back home, the tree outside the hospital window. Then fewer, and fewer. The next spring I hold a screening on the seawall, and that front-row seat stays empty. Only as the crowd leaves do I understand: some words, if you don't say them on the platform, you never get to say at all.

title.zh: 沈澄 · 好结局「第八封信」
title.en: Shen Cheng · Good Ending: The Eighth Letter

text.zh: 第二年春天，咖啡馆重新开张，菜单最上面多了一行：“第一排——热可可，一块棉花糖”。可可罐还在柜子最高的那一格，里面有八个信封。第八封寄出去了，走了七百米，从咖啡馆到老房子。上面只写了一句：“今天也在。”
text.en: The next spring the café reopens, with a new line at the top of the menu: 'The Front Row—hot cocoa, one marshmallow.' The cocoa tin still sits on the highest shelf, and now it holds eight envelopes. The eighth one was actually mailed: seven hundred meters, from the café to the old house. It says only: 'Still here today.'

title.zh: 沈澄 · 普通结局「没有寄出的信」
title.en: Shen Cheng · Normal Ending: Letters Never Sent

text.zh: 回到城里以后，我把七封信一封一封读完了。骂我的那些，骂得很准；别的那些，我读了很多遍。第二年春天，我收到一张明信片，背面是汐川的海，没有署名。我知道是谁。可是这一次，她没有写“等你”。
text.en: Back in the city, I read the seven letters, one after another. The ones that call me names are accurate. The others, I read many times. The next spring, a postcard arrives: the sea at Xichuan on the front, no signature. I know who it's from. But this time, she didn't write 'waiting for you.'

title.zh: 季白 · 好结局「没有影院的电影院」
title.en: Ji Bai · Good Ending: A Cinema Without a Cinema

text.zh: 后来，汐川的海堤上每个周六都放电影，下雨就停。放映员是个戴圆眼镜的研究生，她现在会看完每一部片子的最后一卷，看完了，就去找坐在第一排的那个人。第七卷没有再放过。它说过只放一次，我们答应了它。
text.en: After that, there's a film on the Xichuan seawall every Saturday, cancelled only by rain. The projectionist is a graduate student in round glasses. These days she watches the final reel of every film, and when it's over, she goes to find the person sitting in the front row. Reel seven is never shown again. It said it would be shown only once, and we promised.

title.zh: 季白 · 普通结局「片尾字幕」
title.en: Ji Bai · Normal Ending: End Credits

text.zh: 七月，季白去了北京。第七卷跟着她，住进了恒温恒湿的库房。秋天，她寄来一张照片：她站在一排排胶片架中间，笑得很安静。照片背面写着：“这里的每一部，我都会看完。”我把照片夹进了爷爷的报纸里。
text.en: In July, Ji Bai left for Beijing. Reel seven went with her, into a vault kept at constant temperature and humidity. In autumn she sent a photo: standing among rows and rows of film racks, smiling quietly. On the back: 'Every film here, I'll watch to the end.' I tucked the photo into my grandfather's newspaper.

text.zh: 最后一场放映，你坐在最后一排。散场的时候，银幕上的光一点一点暗下去。春天就这样过去了。
text.en: At the last show you sit in the back row. As the crowd leaves, the light on the screen fades bit by bit. And so the spring passes.

text.zh: 夏知遥在社团群里，第一次叫了你的名字。
text.en: In the club chat, Xia Zhiyao calls you by name for the first time.

text.zh: 沈澄的咖啡馆，那几天打烊总比平时晚一个小时。
text.en: Those nights, Shen Cheng's café always closes an hour late.

text.zh: 放映室的灯，那几周每晚都亮到很晚。
text.en: For those weeks, the light in the booth burns late every night.

text.zh: 这个春天过得很快。你还说不清，自己最想见的是谁。
text.en: The spring goes by fast. You still can't say who you most want to see.

text.zh: 很久以后她才告诉你：那天对着空椅子念宣传词，是她最丢人的一天。也是她第一次觉得，有人在听。
text.en: Much later she tells you: that day, reading the flyer to empty seats, was the most embarrassing day of her life. It was also the first time she felt someone was listening.

text.zh: 拉过钩的事，你做到了。她说，这比那句告白还让她高兴。
text.en: The pinky swear—you kept it. She says that made her happier than the confession.

text.zh: 拉过钩的事，你没有做到。她一直记着。
text.en: The pinky swear—you didn't keep it. She never forgot.

text.zh: 有些人，是你自己说走的。
text.en: Some people, you drove away with your own words.

means.en: asks Xia Zhiyao about her plans after graduation, her family, or the call she declined

text.zh: 她安静了一会儿，才开口：“我妈一个人在家，身体不太好。毕业以后……我得回去。”说完她又笑了：“干嘛突然问这个，怪不好意思的。”
text.en: She's quiet for a moment before she answers. 'My mom's on her own at home, and her health isn't great. After graduation… I have to go back.' Then she laughs. 'Why ask all of a sudden? It's embarrassing.'

means.zh: 向夏知遥承诺：最后一场放映，一定站在她身边 / 陪她把开场白念完
means.en: promises Xia Zhiyao he'll stand beside her at the last screening / help her get through the opening

text.zh: 她愣了一下，伸出小拇指：“拉钩。说话不算数的人，我会记一辈子。”
text.en: She blinks, then holds out her little finger. 'Pinky swear. If you break your word, I'll remember it forever.'

means.zh: 告诉夏知遥，他记得第一天看见她一个人对着空椅子念宣传词的样子（并且觉得那样很好）
means.en: tells Xia Zhiyao he remembers the first day he saw her reading the flyer aloud to empty seats (and that he liked it)

text.zh: 她捂住了脸：“那是我人生最丢人的一天，你居然记得……”指缝里，她的耳朵红透了。
text.en: She covers her face. 'That was the most embarrassing day of my life, and you remember it…' Between her fingers, her ears have gone bright red.

means.zh: 对沈澄说他想起了七年前离开那天的约，或者真心为不告而别道歉
means.en: tells Shen Cheng he remembers the promise from the day he left seven years ago, or sincerely apologizes for leaving without a word

text.zh: 沈澄手里的杯子停在半空。过了很久，她才把它放下：“……七年了，你第一次说这句话。”
text.en: The cup in Shen Cheng's hand stops in midair. A long while passes before she sets it down. '…Seven years, and that's the first time you've said it.'

means.zh: 问季白为什么害怕结束 / 为什么从不看电影的最后一卷
means.en: asks Ji Bai why endings frighten her / why she never watches a film's final reel

text.zh: 季白的手停在胶片上。“……因为看完了，就要承认它结束了。”她笑了笑，“你问了一个没人问过的问题，陆同学。”
text.en: Ji Bai's hands still on the film. '…Because once you've watched it, you have to admit it's over.' She smiles faintly. 'You've asked something no one's ever asked me, Mr. Lu.'
